en: especially / particularly
fr: surtout / notamment
ur: خاص طور پر
definition_en: Compound phrase used to emphasize a specific member or aspect of a group.
example_ar: أُحِبُّ الفَوَاكِهَ، لَا سِيَّمَا التُّفَّاحَ.
example_en: I love fruits, especially apples.

en: soon / shortly
fr: bientôt / sous peu
ur: جلد ہی
definition_en: Temporal phrase indicating that an action will occur in the near future.
example_ar: سَنَلْتَقِي عَمَّا قَرِيبٍ.
example_en: We will meet soon.

en: not only
fr: pas seulement
ur: نہ صرف
definition_en: Correlative phrase often followed by 'bal' (but rather) to indicate multiple aspects.
example_ar: لَيْسَ فَقَطْ هَذَا.
example_en: Not only this.

en: regardless of / irrespective of
fr: indépendamment de / sans tenir compte de
ur: قطع نظر
definition_en: Prepositional phrase used to dismiss a factor as irrelevant to the main point.
example_ar: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الثَّمَنِ.
example_en: Regardless of the price.

en: anyway / in any case
fr: de toute façon / en tout cas
ur: بہر حال
definition_en: Phrase used to dismiss previous details and move to a summary or a new point.
example_ar: عَلَى أَيِّ حَالٍ، سَنَذْهَبُ.
example_en: In any case, we will go.

en: for / regarding / relative to
fr: pour / en ce qui concerne / par rapport à
ur: کے بارے میں / کے لحاظ سے
definition_en: Prepositional phrase used to express a viewpoint or a relationship to something else.
example_ar: بِالنِّسْبَةِ لِي، هَذَا جَيِّدٌ.
example_en: For me (In my view), this is good.

en: who is it that / who
fr: qui est-ce qui / qui
ur: کون ہے وہ جو
definition_en: Emphatic interrogative pronoun used to ask about a person's identity or actions.
example_ar: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ؟
example_en: Who is it that can intercede with Him?

en: provided that / although
fr: à condition que / bien que
ur: اس شرط پر کہ / باوجود یہ کہ
definition_en: Conjunction used to set a condition or to introduce a contrasting fact.
example_ar: سَأُسَاعِدُكَ، عَلَى أَنَّ تَعْدِلَ.
example_en: I will help you, provided that you be just.

en: no problem / it is fine / okay
fr: pas de problème / c'est bien
ur: کوئی بات نہیں / ٹھیک ہے
definition_en: Phrase used to express agreement, reassurance, or that something is acceptable.
example_ar: لَا بَأْسَ، سَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ.
example_en: No problem, I will do that.

en: furthermore / now then (formal transition)
fr: par ailleurs / et maintenant
ur: حمد و ثنا کے بعد
definition_en: Formal transition phrase used in speeches and letters after the introduction to move to the main subject.
example_ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، أَمَّا بَعْدُ...
example_en: Peace be upon you; now then...

en: there is no / there is not
fr: il n'y a pas
ur: وہاں نہیں ہے / نہیں ہے
definition_en: Phrase used to negate the existence of something in a particular place or situation.
example_ar: لَيْسَ هُنَاكَ شَيْءٌ.
example_en: There is nothing.

en: immediately / instantly
fr: tout de suite / instantanément
ur: فوراً
definition_en: Adverbial phrase indicating that an action occurs without any wait or delay.
example_ar: تَعَالَ عَلَى الفَوْرِ.
example_en: Come immediately.

en: to some extent / somewhat
fr: dans une certaine mesure / un peu
ur: کسی حد تک
definition_en: Phrase used to qualify a statement, indicating that it is partially true or limited in degree.
example_ar: هُوَ صَعْبٌ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا.
example_en: It is somewhat difficult.

en: by / on the part of
fr: par / de la part de
ur: کی طرف سے / کے ذریعے
definition_en: Prepositional phrase indicating the source or agent of an action, often used in formal contexts.
example_ar: هَذَا القَرَارُ مِنْ قِبَلِ المُدِيرِ.
example_en: This decision is by the manager.

en: generally / in general
fr: en général / généralement
ur: عام طور پر
definition_en: Adverbial phrase used to indicate that a statement applies to most cases or the whole group.
example_ar: بِشَكْلٍ عَامٍّ، الطَّقْسُ حَارٌ.
example_en: In general, the weather is hot.

en: based on / according to
fr: sur la base de / selon
ur: کی بنیاد پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating the foundation or reason for a conclusion or action.
example_ar: بِنَاءً عَلَى طَلَبِكَ.
example_en: Based on your request.

en: on the other hand
fr: d'autre part / par contre
ur: دوسری طرف
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce a contrasting point or a different perspective on a subject.
example_ar: هُوَ ذَكِيٌّ، وَمِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى هُوَ كَسُولٌ.
example_en: He is smart, and on the other hand, he is lazy.

en: throughout / over the course of
fr: tout au long de / au cours de
ur: کے دوران / پورے
definition_en: Phrase indicating the duration or extent of an action over time or space.
example_ar: عَلَى مَدَارِ السَّنَةِ.
example_en: Throughout the year.

en: no doubt that / undoubtedly
fr: sans doute que / indubitablement
ur: اس میں کوئی شک نہیں کہ
definition_en: Phrase used to express certainty about a statement.
example_ar: لَا شَكَّ أَنَّ الصِّدْقَ مَنْجَاةٌ.
example_en: No doubt that honesty is salvation.

en: supposed to / presumably
fr: censé / supposé que
ur: فرض کیا جاتا ہے کہ / ہونا چاہیے کہ
definition_en: Phrase indicating an expectation or a theoretical assumption about an action.
example_ar: مِنَ المُفْتَرَضِ أَنْ نَصِلَ الآنَ.
example_en: We are supposed to arrive now.

en: to the maximum extent / as much as possible
fr: au maximum / autant que possible
ur: زیادہ سے زیادہ
definition_en: Phrase indicating the highest limit or degree of something.
example_ar: اِسْتَمْتَعْتُ لِأَقْصَى حَدٍّ.
example_en: I enjoyed myself to the maximum extent.

en: from time to time / occasionally
fr: de temps en temps / occasionnellement
ur: وقت فوقت / کبھی کبھی
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action occurs at irregular intervals.
example_ar: أَزُورُهُ مِنْ وَقْتٍ لِآخَرَ.
example_en: I visit him from time to time.

en: regardless of
fr: indépendamment de
ur: قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase used to exclude a particular factor or circumstance from consideration.
example_ar: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الظُّرُوفِ.
example_en: Regardless of the circumstances.

en: especially / particularly
fr: particulièrement / spécialement
ur: خاص طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to emphasize a specific instance or a member of a group.
example_ar: أُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضَةَ، بِصِفَةٍ خَاصَّةٍ السِّبَاحَةَ.
example_en: I love sports, especially swimming.

en: likely to / probably
fr: probable que / vraisemblablement
ur: غالب گمان ہے کہ
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that something is more likely true or expected to happen than not.
example_ar: مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ أَنْ تُمْطِرَ اليَوْمَ.
example_en: It is likely to rain today.

en: must / it is necessary that
fr: il faut que / devoir
ur: ہونا چاہیے کہ / لازمی ہے
definition_en: Phrase used to express an absolute necessity or an inescapable conclusion.
example_ar: لَا بُدَّ أَنْ نَذْهَبَ الآنَ.
example_en: We must go now.

en: in any case / anyway
fr: de toute façon / quoi qu'il en soit
ur: بہرحال
definition_en: Phrase used to summarize or dismiss previous points and move on.
example_ar: عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ، شُكْرًا لَكَ.
example_en: Anyway, thank you.

en: from my point of view
fr: de mon point de vue
ur: میری نظر میں / میرے نقطہ نظر سے
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce one's personal opinion or perspective on a matter.
example_ar: مِنْ وَجْهَةِ نَظَرِي، هَذَا خَطَأٌ.
example_en: From my point of view, this is a mistake.

en: from one side / on one hand
fr: d'un côté / d'une part
ur: ایک لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the first part of a comparison or a multi-faceted argument.
example_ar: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ، هِيَ جَمِيلَةٌ.
example_en: On one hand, she is beautiful.

en: of his own accord / spontaneously
fr: de son propre chef / spontanément
ur: خود بخود / اپنی مرضی سے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action done without external pressure or invitation.
example_ar: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ نَفْسِهِ.
example_en: He did that of his own accord.

en: without a doubt / certainly
fr: sans aucun doute / certainement
ur: بلاشبہ
definition_en: Phrase used to express total certainty or conviction about a statement.
example_ar: أَنْتَ مُحِقٌّ بِلا شَكٍّ.
example_en: You are right without a doubt.

en: since / because / as
fr: puisque / comme
ur: چونکہ / اس لیے کہ
definition_en: Conjunction used to introduce a known or established reason for a subsequent statement.
example_ar: بِمَا أَنَّكَ هُنَا، فَلْنَذْهَبْ.
example_en: Since you are here, let's go.

en: despite / in spite of
fr: malgré / en dépit de
ur: کے باوجود
definition_en: Prepositional phrase used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main clause.
example_ar: نَجَحَ عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنَ الصُّعُوبَاتِ.
example_en: He succeeded despite the difficulties.

en: nevertheless / however / even so
fr: néanmoins / pourtant / tout de même
ur: اس کے باوجود / پھر بھی
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was just said.
example_ar: كَانَ مَرِيضًا، وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ جَاءَ.
example_en: He was sick, and nevertheless he came.

en: from time to time / occasionally
fr: de temps en temps
ur: کبھی کبھی / وقت فوقت
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action occurs intermittently or not very often.
example_ar: نَلْتَقِي مِنْ حِينٍ لِآخَرَ.
example_en: We meet from time to time.

en: from my side / as for me
fr: de mon côté / pour ma part
ur: میری طرف سے
definition_en: Phrase used to express one's own position or willingness in a situation.
example_ar: مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي، أَنَا مُوَافِقٌ.
example_en: As for me, I agree.

en: regardless of what
fr: peu importe ce que / quoi qu'il en soit de
ur: قطع نظر اس سے کہ کیا
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that the following action or fact is irrelevant to the outcome.
example_ar: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَمَّا حَدَثَ.
example_en: Regardless of what happened.

en: in the end / ultimately
fr: en fin de compte / finalement
ur: آخرکار / انجام کار
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase referring to the final result or conclusion of a process or event.
example_ar: فِي آخِرِ المَطَافِ، الحَقِيقَةُ تَظْهَرُ.
example_en: In the end, the truth appears.

en: likely to / calculated to / which would
fr: de nature à / susceptible de
ur: اس کا مقصد ہے کہ / اس سے ہو سکتا ہے
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action or factor has the potential or tendency to cause a result.
example_ar: هَذَا مِنْ شَأْنِهِ أَنْ يُسَاعِدَنَا.
example_en: This is likely to help us.

en: including / as well as
fr: y compris / ainsi que
ur: بشمول / اس سمیت
definition_en: Phrase used to specify that certain items or people are part of a larger group mentioned.
example_ar: جَاءَ الجَمِيعُ، بِمَا فِي ذَلِكَ أَحْمَدُ.
example_en: Everyone came, including Ahmad.

en: with regard to / concerning
fr: en ce qui concerne / concernant
ur: کے متعلق / کے بارے میں
definition_en: Formal phrase used to introduce a specific topic or subject of discussion.
example_ar: فِيمَا يَتَعَلَّقُ بِالعَمَلِ.
example_en: With regard to the work.

en: for the sake of clarification
fr: à des fins de clarification
ur: وضاحت کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when providing extra details to ensure a point is understood correctly.
example_ar: أَقُولُ ذَلِكَ بِغَرَضِ التَّوْضِيحِ.
example_en: I say that for the sake of clarification.

en: to a large extent / greatly
fr: dans une large mesure / grandement
ur: کافی حد تک
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a statement is true to a high degree or a significant distance.
example_ar: نَجَحْنَا إِلَى حَدٍّ بَعِيدٍ.
example_en: We succeeded to a large extent.

en: by some / on the part of some
fr: par certains / de la part de certains
ur: بعض کی طرف سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is attributed to an unspecified group of people.
example_ar: هُنَاكَ اِعْتِرَاضٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ البَعْضِ.
example_en: There is an objection by some.

en: it is difficult to
fr: il est difficile de
ur: مشکل ہے کہ
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that a specific action is hard or unlikely to be achieved.
example_ar: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ أَنْ تَنْسَى.
example_en: It is difficult to forget.

en: quite the opposite / on the contrary
fr: tout au contraire / bien au contraire
ur: اس کے بالکل برعکس
definition_en: Phrase used to emphasize that the reality is the exact opposite of what was suggested.
example_ar: هُوَ لَيْسَ حَزِينًا، عَلَى العَكْسِ تَمَامًا.
example_en: He is not sad; quite the opposite.

en: in this regard / in this context
fr: à cet égard / dans ce contexte
ur: اس سلسلے میں
definition_en: Phrase used to connect a statement to the specific topic currently being discussed.
example_ar: وَفِي هَذَا الصَّدَدِ، نَقُولُ...
example_en: And in this regard, we say...

en: without the slightest doubt
fr: sans le moindre doute
ur: بغیر کسی شک و شبہ کے
definition_en: Emphatic phrase used to express absolute and unquestionable certainty.
example_ar: هُوَ البَطَلُ بِدُونِ أَدْنَى شَكٍّ.
example_en: He is the hero without the slightest doubt.

en: in principle / theoretically
fr: en principe / en théorie
ur: اصولی طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate agreement with the basic idea of something, even if details are not yet settled.
example_ar: أَنَا مُوَافِقٌ مِنْ حَيْثُ المَبْدَأِ.
example_en: I agree in principle.

en: anyway / regardless
fr: de toute façon / quoi qu'il en soit
ur: بہرحال
definition_en: Shortened version of 'ala kulli hal', used to dismiss details and move to a conclusion.
example_ar: عَلَى كُلٍّ، أَنَا ذَاهِبٌ.
example_en: Anyway, I am going.

en: in the future
fr: à l'avenir / dans le futur
ur: مستقبل میں / آنے والے وقت میں
definition_en: Temporal phrase referring to the time that is yet to come.
example_ar: سَأُسَافِرُ فِي المَسْتَقْبَلِ.
example_en: I will travel in the future.

en: especially since / particularly because
fr: d'autant plus que / surtout que
ur: خاص طور پر اس لیے کہ
definition_en: Compound phrase used to emphasize a reason or cause for a statement.
example_ar: هُوَ مَاهِرٌ، لَا سِيَّمَا أَنَّهُ تَدَرَّبَ كَثِيرًا.
example_en: He is skilled, especially since he trained a lot.

en: it is necessary to
fr: il est nécessaire de
ur: ضروری ہے کہ
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that a specific action is required or essential.
example_ar: مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ أَنْ تَدْرُسَ.
example_en: It is necessary that you study.

en: as soon as / once
fr: dès que / aussitôt que
ur: جیسے ہی
definition_en: Conjunction indicating that one action will occur immediately after another.
example_ar: بِمُجَرَّدِ أَنْ أَصِلَ، سَأَتَّصِلُ بِكَ.
example_en: As soon as I arrive, I will call you.

en: in a way / in a manner
fr: d'une manière / d'une façon
ur: اس طرح سے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe the method or style in which an action is performed.
example_ar: هُوَ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى نَحْوٍ جَيِّدٍ.
example_en: He works in a good manner.

en: from a perspective / from a point of view
fr: d'un point de vue
ur: ایک نقطہ نظر سے
definition_en: Phrase introducing a specific angle or way of looking at a subject.
example_ar: مِنْ وِجْهَةِ نَظَرٍ اقْتِصَادِيَّةٍ.
example_en: From an economic perspective.

en: in contrast to / compared with
fr: par rapport à / contrairement à
ur: کے مقابلے میں
definition_en: Phrase used to highlight differences between two entities or situations.
example_ar: هَذَا جَيِّدٌ بِالمُقَابِلِ لِذَاكَ.
example_en: This is good in contrast to that.

en: within / during the course of
fr: au cours de / dans l'espace de
ur: کے دوران / کے اندر
definition_en: Temporal phrase indicating the duration within which an event occurs.
example_ar: فِي غُضُونِ أُسْبُوعٍ.
example_en: Within a week.

en: in vain / to no avail
fr: en vain / inutilement
ur: بے سود / لا حاصل
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action was performed but did not achieve the desired result.
example_ar: حَاوَلْتُ بِدُونِ جَدْوَى.
example_en: I tried in vain.

en: in any case / by any means (often negative: by no means)
fr: de toute façon / en aucun cas
ur: کسی بھی صورت میں
definition_en: Strong emphatic phrase used to indicate that a statement holds true under all circumstances.
example_ar: لَا تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ بِأَيِّ حَالٍ مِنَ الأَحْوَالِ.
example_en: Do not do that by any means.

en: technically / from a technical standpoint
fr: techniquement / d'un point de vue technique
ur: فنی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase used to narrow the focus of a discussion to technical details or rules.
example_ar: هَذَا مُمْكِنٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَقْنِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This is possible technically.

en: according to him / as he said
fr: selon lui / comme il l'a dit
ur: اس کے بقول / جیسا کہ اس نے کہا
definition_en: Phrase used to attribute a statement or an idea to a specific person.
example_ar: عَلَى حَدِّ قَوْلِهِ، الأَمْرُ سَهْلٌ.
example_en: According to him, the matter is easy.

en: in return for that / in exchange for that
fr: en échange de cela / en contrepartie
ur: اس کے بدلے میں
definition_en: Phrase indicating a response or a trade-off for a previously mentioned action or thing.
example_ar: أَعْطَيْتُهُ مَالاً، وَبِالمُقَابِلِ لِذَلِكَ سَاعَدَنِي.
example_en: I gave him money, and in return for that, he helped me.

en: in the first place / primarily
fr: en premier lieu / d'abord
ur: سب سے پہلے / اولاً
definition_en: Phrase used to emphasize the most important reason or factor in a situation.
example_ar: هِيَ أُمٌّ فِي المَقَامِ الأَوَّلِ.
example_en: She is a mother in the first place.

en: beyond any doubt / leaving no room for doubt
fr: sans l'ombre d'un doute / sans équivoque
ur: بغیر کسی شک و شبہ کے
definition_en: Strong idiomatic expression used to assert that something is absolutely certain.
example_ar: هُوَ مَذْنِبٌ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلشَّكِّ.
example_en: He is guilty beyond any doubt.

en: for the purpose of verification / to check
fr: aux fins de vérification / pour vérifier
ur: تصدیق کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed to ensure the accuracy or truth of something.
example_ar: اِتَّصَلْتُ بِهِ بِغَرَضِ التَّحَقُّقِ.
example_en: I called him for the purpose of verification.

en: on his shoulders / as his responsibility
fr: sur ses épaules / sous sa responsabilité
ur: اس کے کندھوں پر / اس کی ذمہ داری
definition_en: Idiomatic expression indicating that someone bears a heavy burden or responsibility.
example_ar: تَقَعُ المَسْؤُولِيَّةُ عَلَى كَاهِلِهِ.
example_en: The responsibility lies on his shoulders.

en: in line with / consistent with
fr: conformément à / en accord avec
ur: کے مطابق / کے ہم آہنگ
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action or idea is in harmony or agreement with a set of rules or conditions.
example_ar: هَذَا بِمَا يَتَمَاشَى مَعَ القَانُونِ.
example_en: This is in line with the law.

en: without exception
fr: sans exception
ur: بلا استثناء
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that a statement applies to every single member of a group.
example_ar: الكُلُّ مَدْعُوُّونَ بِلا اسْتِثْنَاءٍ.
example_en: Everyone is invited without exception.

en: essentially / fundamentally
fr: essentiellement / fondamentalement
ur: بنیادی طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to focus on the most important or core aspect of a matter.
example_ar: المَشْرُوعُ جَيِّدٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ جَوْهَرِيَّةٍ.
example_en: The project is good essentially.

en: ultimately / in the end
fr: en fin de compte / finalement
ur: آخرکار / قصہ مختصر
definition_en: Phrase used to describe the final outcome after all factors have been considered.
example_ar: فِي نِهَايَةِ الأَمْرِ، سَنَنْجَحُ.
example_en: Ultimately, we will succeed.

en: regardless of the results
fr: quels que soient les résultats
ur: نتائج سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action will be taken irrespective of what the outcome might be.
example_ar: سَنُحَاوِلُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ النَّتَائِجِ.
example_en: We will try regardless of the results.

en: on the verge of / about to
fr: sur le point de / à la veille de
ur: کے قریب / ہونے والا ہے
definition_en: Prepositional phrase indicating that an action is very close to happening.
example_ar: هُوَ عَلَى وَشْكِ الوُصُولِ.
example_en: He is about to arrive.

en: by pure chance / accidentally
fr: par pur hasard
ur: محض اتفاق سے
definition_en: Emphatic phrase used to indicate that something happened entirely without planning.
example_ar: نَجَحَ بِمَحْضِ الصُّدْفَةِ.
example_en: He succeeded by pure chance.

en: while / whereas / at a time when
fr: alors que / tandis que
ur: جبکہ
definition_en: Conjunction used to highlight a contrast between two simultaneous facts or situations.
example_ar: هُوَ يَعْمَلُ، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ أَخَاهُ يَلْعَبُ.
example_en: He works, while his brother plays.

en: over the course of the century
fr: au cours du siècle
ur: صدی کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe developments or trends that spanned a hundred years.
example_ar: تَطَوَّرَتِ التِّكْنُولُوجِيَا عَلَى مَدَى القَرْنِ.
example_en: Technology evolved over the course of the century.

en: for the purpose of experimentation / as a trial
fr: à des fins d'expérimentation / à titre d'essai
ur: تجربے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed to test a theory or a method.
example_ar: سَنُجَرِّبُ هَذَا بِغَرَضِ التَّجْرِبَةِ.
example_en: We will try this as a trial.

en: in the midst of events / during the turmoil
fr: au cœur des événements / au milieu de l'agitation
ur: واقعات کی بھرمار میں / ہنگاموں کے دوران
definition_en: Idiomatic expression describing a situation in the middle of busy or chaotic occurrences.
example_ar: نَسِيَ نَفْسَهُ فِي غَمْرَةِ الأَحْدَاثِ.
example_en: He forgot himself in the midst of events.

en: unambiguous / leaving no room for interpretation
fr: sans équivoque / ne prêtant pas à interprétation
ur: غیر مبہم / جس کی کوئی اور تاویل نہ ہو سکے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a statement or fact that is clear and has only one possible meaning.
example_ar: كَانَ قَرَارُهُ بِمَا لَا يَقْبَلُ التَّأْوِيلَ.
example_en: His decision was unambiguous.

en: hard to believe
fr: difficile à croire
ur: یقین کرنا مشکل ہے
definition_en: Phrase used when a fact or story is so extraordinary or unlikely that it challenges belief.
example_ar: هَذَا الخَبَرُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَصَدِّيقُهُ.
example_en: This news is hard to believe.

en: in this regard / regarding this matter
fr: à ce sujet / à cet égard
ur: اس معاملے میں
definition_en: Phrase used to connect a statement to the specific issue or business being discussed.
example_ar: مَا هُوَ رَأْيُكَ فِي هَذَا الشَّأْنِ؟
example_en: What is your opinion in this regard?

en: without prior warning / suddenly
fr: sans préavis / sans avertissement préalable
ur: بغیر کسی پیشگی اطلاع کے
definition_en: Phrase used when an event occurs unexpectedly and without any signs leading up to it.
example_ar: اِسْتَقَالَ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ إِنْذَارٍ.
example_en: He resigned without prior warning.

en: fundamentally / in principle
fr: en principe / fondamentalement
ur: اصولی طور پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the core principles or basics of an agreement or idea.
example_ar: هُوَ مُوَافِقٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ مَبْدَئِيَّةٍ.
example_en: He agrees in principle.

en: at the last moment
fr: au dernier moment
ur: آخری لمحے میں
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action occurred just before a deadline or a critical point.
example_ar: أَلْغَى الرِّحْلَةَ فِي آخِرِ لَحْظَةٍ.
example_en: He canceled the trip at the last moment.

en: regardless of the circumstances
fr: quelles que soient les circonstances
ur: حالات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action holds true or will be taken no matter what the environment or conditions are.
example_ar: سَنُوَاصِلُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الظُّرُوفِ.
example_en: We will continue regardless of the circumstances.

en: on the edge of / on the brink of
fr: au bord de / sur le point de
ur: کے کنارے پر / کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Prepositional phrase indicating proximity to a physical edge or a figurative crisis/change.
example_ar: عَلَى حَافَّةِ الهاوِيَةِ.
example_en: On the edge of the abyss.

en: of his own free will / voluntarily
fr: de son plein gré / volontairement
ur: اپنی مرضی سے
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that an action was taken without any external compulsion or force.
example_ar: تَرَكَ العَمَلَ بِمَحْضِ إِرَادَتِهِ.
example_en: He left the job of his own free will.

en: in case / if it happens that
fr: au cas où / dans l'éventualité où
ur: ایسی صورت میں اگر
definition_en: Conditional phrase used to introduce a potential future scenario and the corresponding response.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِي فِي حَالَةِ مَا إِذَا احْتَجْتَ شَيْئًا.
example_en: Call me in case you need something.

en: since we / because we
fr: puisque nous / comme nous
ur: چونکہ ہم
definition_en: Conjunction phrase used to introduce a reason or context specifically involving the speaker and others.
example_ar: بِمَا أَنَّنَا هُنَا، فَلْنَبْدَأْ.
example_en: Since we are here, let's begin.

en: practically / from a practical standpoint
fr: d'un point de vue pratique / pratiquement
ur: عملی طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to evaluate a situation based on real-world application rather than theory.
example_ar: هَذَا صَعْبٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ عَمَلِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This is difficult practically.

en: over the days / day after day
fr: au fil des jours
ur: جوں جوں دن گزرتے گئے
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing a gradual process or a repeated action over a short period of time.
example_ar: تَعَلَّمْتُ كَثِيرًا عَلَى مَدَى الأَيَّامِ.
example_en: I learned a lot over the days.

en: sufficiently / enough
fr: suffisamment / assez
ur: ضرورت کے مطابق / کافی حد تک
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a quantity or degree is adequate for the situation.
example_ar: نِمْتُ بِمَا فِيهِ الكِفَايَةُ.
example_en: I slept sufficiently.

en: by everyone / on the part of all
fr: par tout le monde / de la part de tous
ur: سب کی طرف سے
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate universal agreement or participation in an action.
example_ar: هَذَا مَقْبُولٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الجَمِيعِ.
example_en: This is accepted by everyone.

en: compared with / in comparison to
fr: par comparaison avec / par rapport à
ur: کے مقابلے میں
definition_en: Phrase used to contrast two entities to highlight their differences or similarities.
example_ar: هُوَ طَوِيلٌ بِالمُقَارَنَةِ مَعَ أَخِيهِ.
example_en: He is tall compared with his brother.

en: without any delay / promptly
fr: sans aucun retard / sans tarder
ur: بغیر کسی تاخیر کے
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that an action must be performed immediately.
example_ar: اِفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ بِدُونِ أَيِّ تَأْخِيرٍ.
example_en: Do that without any delay.

en: partially / from a partial standpoint
fr: partiellement / d'un point de vue partiel
ur: جزئی طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that a statement applies only to a part of the whole.
example_ar: هَذَا صَحِيحٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ جُزْئِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This is partially correct.

en: in general / generally speaking
fr: en général / d'une manière générale
ur: عام طور پر
definition_en: Adverbial phrase used to indicate that a statement is true for most of the time or for most people.
example_ar: عَلَى العُمُومِ، الحَيَاةُ صَعْبَةٌ.
example_en: In general, life is difficult.

en: in this context
fr: dans ce contexte
ur: اس تناظر میں
definition_en: Phrase used to link a statement to the specific surrounding circumstances or the flow of a discussion.
example_ar: سَنُقَرِّرُ فِي هَذَا السِّيَاقِ.
example_en: We will decide in this context.

en: without exaggeration / literally
fr: sans exagération / littéralement
ur: مبالغہ آرائی کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used to assert that a statement is accurately true even if it sounds extreme.
example_ar: هُوَ عَبْقَرِيٌّ بِدُونِ مُبَالَغَةٍ.
example_en: He is a genius without exaggeration.

en: in the end / after all
fr: finalement / après tout
ur: آخرکار / قصہ مختصر
definition_en: Phrase used to express the final outcome or conclusion.
example_ar: فِي نِهَايَةِ المَطَافِ، سَنَرَى.
example_en: In the end, we will see.

en: lifelong / over a lifetime
fr: tout au long de la vie
ur: تاحیات / پوری زندگی
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe an action or condition that lasts for the duration of a person's life.
example_ar: التَّعَلُّمُ عَلَى مَدَى الحَيَاةِ.
example_en: Lifelong learning.

en: for information / for review
fr: pour information / pour examen
ur: معلومات کی غرض سے / مطالعے کے لیے
definition_en: Phrase used when a document or fact is provided so that someone can become aware of its contents.
example_ar: أَرْسَلْتُهُ بِغَرَضِ الاطِّلاعِ.
example_en: I sent it for information.

en: in the second place / secondly
fr: en second lieu / deuxièmement
ur: دوسرے نمبر پر / ثانیاً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the second most important point or reason in a sequence.
example_ar: هُوَ عَمَلِيٌّ فِي المَقَامِ الثَّانِي.
example_en: He is practical in the second place.

en: beyond any suspicion / leaving no room for doubt
fr: sans l'ombre d'un doute / hors de tout soupçon
ur: بلا ریب و شک
definition_en: Strong emphatic phrase used to assert that something is absolutely and purely true.
example_ar: هَذِهِ الحَقِيقَةُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلرَّيْبِ.
example_en: This is the truth beyond any suspicion.

en: it is easy to
fr: il est facile de
ur: آسان ہے کہ
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that a specific action requires little effort or is simple to achieve.
example_ar: مِنَ السَّهْلِ أَنْ تَقُولَ ذَلِكَ.
example_en: It is easy to say that.

en: around the clock / 24/7
fr: 24 heures sur 24 / en permanence
ur: چوبیس گھنٹے / ہر وقت
definition_en: Idiomatic expression indicating that an action or service is available or happening continuously.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ عَلَى مَدَارِ السَّاعَةِ.
example_en: We work around the clock.

en: in this framework / within this context
fr: dans ce cadre / dans ce contexte
ur: اس فریم ورک میں / اس دائرہ کار میں
definition_en: Phrase used to link a statement to the specific structural or conceptual limits of a discussion.
example_ar: سَنَتَعَاوَنُ فِي هَذَا الإِطَارِ.
example_en: We will cooperate within this framework.

en: unintentionally / accidentally
fr: sans intention / par accident
ur: غیر ارادی طور پر / انجانے میں
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action that happened without the person planning it or meaning to do it.
example_ar: فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ بِدُونِ قَصْدٍ.
example_en: I did that unintentionally.

en: regardless of the consequences
fr: quelles que soient les conséquences
ur: نتائج / عواقب سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken even if the results are potentially negative or unknown.
example_ar: سَأَفْعَلُهُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ العَوَاقِبِ.
example_en: I will do it regardless of the consequences.

en: on the brink of / on the edge of
fr: au bord de / sur le point de
ur: کے دہانے پر / کے کنارے پر
definition_en: Prepositional phrase similar to 'ala haffa', often used to describe a dangerous or critical state.
example_ar: عَلَى شَفَا الاِنْهِيَارِ.
example_en: On the brink of collapse.

en: at his absolute discretion / as he sees fit
fr: à sa seule discrétion
ur: اس کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that an action or choice is entirely up to the judgment of one specific person.
example_ar: لَهُ الحَقُّ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِهِ.
example_en: He has the right at his absolute discretion.

en: in the meantime / meanwhile
fr: entre-temps / pendant ce temps-là
ur: اس دوران / اسی اثناء میں
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe an action occurring simultaneously with another or in the interval between events.
example_ar: اِنْتَظِرْ، وَفِي غُضُونِ ذَلِكَ سَأَحْضُرُ الشَّايَ.
example_en: Wait; in the meantime, I will bring tea.

en: at all levels
fr: à tous les niveaux
ur: تمام سطحوں پر / ہر سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a statement or condition applies throughout various tiers or areas of a system.
example_ar: التَّعَاوُنُ عَلَى كُلِّ المَسْتَوَيَاتِ.
example_en: Cooperation at all levels.

en: in the third place / thirdly
fr: en troisième lieu / troisièmement
ur: تیسرے نمبر پر / ثالثاً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the third point or reason in a sequence.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّالِثِ، التَّكْلِفَةُ.
example_en: And thirdly, the cost.

en: beyond reproach / leaving no room for criticism
fr: irréprochable / sans faille
ur: جس پر کوئی تنقید نہ ہو سکے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe something done so perfectly that it cannot be faulted.
example_ar: كَانَ العَمَلُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْتِقَادِ.
example_en: The work was beyond reproach.

en: from time to time / occasionally
fr: de temps en temps
ur: کبھی کبھار / وقت بہ وقت
definition_en: Phrase used to say that something happens occasionally or at irregular intervals.
example_ar: نَلْتَقِي مِنْ آوِنَةٍ لِأُخْرَى.
example_en: We meet from time to time.

en: hard to ignore / noticeable
fr: difficile à ignorer
ur: نظر انداز کرنا مشکل ہے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe something significant or prominent that demands attention.
example_ar: هَذَا التَّطَوُّرُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَجَاهُلُهُ.
example_en: This development is hard to ignore.

en: in this case / in this situation
fr: dans ce cas / dans cette situation
ur: اس صورت میں / اس حالت میں
definition_en: Phrase used to narrow the context to the specific circumstances just mentioned.
example_ar: فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ، سَنَنْتَظِرُ.
example_en: In this case, we will wait.

en: without thinking / instinctively / thoughtlessly
fr: sans réfléchir / instinctivement
ur: سوچے سمجھے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action done rapidly or without prior consideration.
example_ar: أَجَابَ بِدُونِ تَفْكِيرٍ.
example_en: He answered without thinking.

en: in the foreseeable future
fr: dans un avenir proche
ur: قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to the period of time that can be predicted based on current trends.
example_ar: لَا نَتَوَقَّعُ تَغْيِيرًا فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ.
example_en: We don't expect change in the foreseeable future.

en: regardless of the costs
fr: quel qu'en soit le coût
ur: اخراجات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken irrespective of the financial burden.
example_ar: سَنُنْجِزُ المَشْرُوعَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّكَالِيفِ.
example_en: We will complete the project regardless of the costs.

en: near to / in the vicinity of
fr: à proximité de / près de
ur: کے قریب / کے نزدیک
definition_en: Prepositional phrase indicating physical closeness to a specific location.
example_ar: كُنَّا عَلَى مَقْرُبَةٍ مِنَ المَدِينَةِ.
example_en: We were near the city.

en: at your own discretion
fr: à votre propre discrétion
ur: آپ کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the choice or decision is entirely up to the listener.
example_ar: الأَمْرُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ.
example_en: The matter is at your own discretion.

en: in the midst of joy / overwhelmed with joy
fr: au comble de la joie / dans l'allégresse
ur: خوشی کے عالم میں / بے حد خوشی میں
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase describing a state where someone is completely absorbed in or overwhelmed by happiness.
example_ar: نَسِيَ هُمُومَهُ فِي غَمْرَةِ الفَرَحِ.
example_en: He forgot his worries in the midst of joy.

en: on all tracks / in all directions
fr: sur tous les fronts / dans toutes les directions
ur: تمام راستوں پر / ہر محاذ پر
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate that progress or actions are happening across multiple domains or paths simultaneously.
example_ar: التَّقَدُّمُ مُسْتَمِرٌّ عَلَى كُلِّ المَسَارَاتِ.
example_en: Progress is ongoing on all tracks.

en: in the fourth place / fourthly
fr: en quatrième lieu / quatrièmement
ur: چوتھے نمبر پر / رابعاً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the fourth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الرَّابِعِ، الوَقْتُ.
example_en: And fourthly, the time.

en: foolproof / leaving no room for error
fr: infaillible / sans aucune erreur possible
ur: جس میں غلطی کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a system or plan that is so well-designed that failure is nearly impossible.
example_ar: صَمَّمْنَا النِّظَامَ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلخَطَأِ.
example_en: We designed the system to be foolproof.

en: from one moment to another / imminently
fr: d'un moment à l'autre / incessamment
ur: ایک لمحے سے دوسرے لمحے تک / کسی بھی وقت
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an event that is expected to happen very soon or is constantly changing.
example_ar: نَتَوَقَّعُ وُصُولَهُ مِنْ لَحْظَةٍ لِأُخْرَى.
example_en: We expect his arrival at any moment.

en: undeniable / hard to deny
fr: indéniable / difficile à nier
ur: جس سے انکار کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a fact or truth that is so obvious it cannot be refuted.
example_ar: نَجَاحُهُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ نِكْرَانُهُ.
example_en: His success is undeniable.

en: at this point / on this matter
fr: sur ce point / à ce stade
ur: اس نکتے پر / اس مقام پر
definition_en: Phrase used to focus the discussion on a specific detail or a specific moment in time.
example_ar: أَنَا أَتَّفِقُ مَعَكَ فِي هَذِهِ النُّقْطَةِ.
example_en: I agree with you on this point.

en: without hesitation / unhesitatingly
fr: sans hésitation / sans hésiter
ur: بغیر کسی ہچکچاہٹ کے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action taken with confidence, speed, and certainty.
example_ar: وَافَقَ عَلَى العَرْضِ بِدُونِ تَرَدُّدٍ.
example_en: He agreed to the offer without hesitation.

en: in the medium term
fr: à moyen terme
ur: درمیانی مدت میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to a period of time that is neither immediate nor very distant (usually 1-5 years).
example_ar: سَتَظْهَرُ النَّتَائِجُ فِي المَدَى المَتَوَسِّطِ.
example_en: Results will appear in the medium term.

en: regardless of the differences
fr: quelles que soient les différences / malgré les divergences
ur: اختلافات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that cooperation or a statement holds true despite the presence of diversity or disagreement.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ مَعًا بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِخْتِلَافَاتِ.
example_en: We work together regardless of the differences.

en: close to the end / near completion
fr: proche de la fin / presque fini
ur: اختتام کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a process or event is almost finished.
example_ar: المَشْرُوعُ عَلَى مَقْرُبَةٍ مِنَ النِّهَايَةِ.
example_en: The project is near completion.

en: of his own desire / voluntarily
fr: de son propre désir / selon ses envies
ur: اپنی مرضی / خواہش سے
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that an action was taken purely because the person wanted to do it.
example_ar: شَارَكَ فِي العَمَلِ بِمَحْضِ رَغْبَتِهِ.
example_en: He participated in the work of his own desire.

en: in the event of an error / if something goes wrong
fr: en cas d'erreur / si une erreur survient
ur: غلطی ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions or a plan for when things do not go as expected.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِي فِي حَالِ حُدُوثِ خَطَأٍ.
example_en: Call me in the event of an error.

en: on all levels / in all fields
fr: à tous les niveaux / sur tous les plans
ur: تمام سطحوں پر / ہر لحاظ سے
definition_en: (Similar to 'ala kulli al-mastawayat'). Phrase indicating that something applies universally across all domains or ranks.
example_ar: التَّعَاوُنُ عَلَى كُلِّ الأَصْعِدَةِ.
example_en: Cooperation at all levels.

en: in the fifth place / fifthly
fr: en cinquième lieu / cinquièmement
ur: پانچویں نمبر پر / خامساً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the fifth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الخَامِسِ، النَّتِيجَةُ.
example_en: And fifthly, the result.

en: unquestionable / leaving no room for questioning
fr: incontestable / ne laissant planer aucun doute
ur: جس پر کوئی سوال نہ اٹھایا جا سکے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a fact or decision that is so clear and justified that it cannot be challenged.
example_ar: كَانَ العُذْرُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّسَاؤُلِ.
example_en: The excuse was unquestionable.

en: from time to time / periodically
fr: de temps en temps / périodiquement
ur: وقت بہ وقت
definition_en: (Similar to 'ala fatarat'). Phrase describing an action that happens at intervals over time.
example_ar: نُحَدِّثُ المَعْلُومَاتِ مِنْ فَتْرَةٍ لِأُخْرَى.
example_en: We update the information from time to time.

en: hard to avoid / inevitable
fr: difficile à éviter / inévitable
ur: جس سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe something that is certain to happen or cannot be easily circumvented.
example_ar: هَذَا الخَطَرُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَجَنُّبُهُ.
example_en: This danger is hard to avoid.

en: at this stage / at this phase
fr: à ce stade / à cette étape
ur: اس مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase used to indicate the current point in a process or period of development.
example_ar: نَحْنُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ نُخَطِّطُ.
example_en: We are at this stage planning.

en: without delay / immediately
fr: sans tarder / sans délai
ur: تاخیر کے بغیر
definition_en: (Similar to 'bidun ayyi takhir'). Phrase emphasizing the urgency of an action.
example_ar: سَلِّمِ العَمَلَ بِدُونِ تَأَخُّرٍ.
example_en: Submit the work without delay.

en: in the long run / in the long term
fr: à long terme
ur: طویل مدت میں / لمبے عرصے میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to the period of time far in the future or the ultimate outcome of a process.
example_ar: سَيَكُونُ هَذَا مُفِيدًا فِي المَدَى البَعِيدِ.
example_en: This will be useful in the long run.

en: regardless of the situation
fr: quelle que soit la situation
ur: صورتحال سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a statement or commitment holds true no matter what the current circumstances are.
example_ar: سَأُسَاعِدُكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ المَوْقِفِ.
example_en: I will help you regardless of the situation.

en: on equal footing / as equals
fr: sur un pied d'égalité / à égalité
ur: برابری کی سطح پر
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase used to indicate that two or more parties are treated or acting with the same rights and status.
example_ar: نَحْنُ نَعْمَلُ عَلَى قَدَمِ المُسَاوَاةِ.
example_en: We work on equal footing.

en: of his own choice / by his own selection
fr: par son propre choix
ur: اپنی پسند سے
definition_en: (Similar to 'bimahdi iradatihi'). Phrase emphasizing that an action was a result of the person's own preference.
example_ar: قَرَّرَ ذَلِكَ بِمَحْضِ اِخْتِيَارِهِ.
example_en: He decided that by his own choice.

en: under the current circumstances / given the present situation
fr: dans les circonstances actuelles / compte tenu de la situation actuelle
ur: موجودہ حالات کے پیش نظر
definition_en: Phrase used to qualify a statement by the reality of the existing situation.
example_ar: هَذَا مُمْكِنٌ فِي ظِلِّ الظُّرُوفِ الرَّاهِنَةِ.
example_en: This is possible under the current circumstances.

en: to the best of my knowledge / as far as I know
fr: à ma connaissance / autant que je sache
ur: جہاں تک مجھے معلوم ہے
definition_en: Phrase used to qualify a statement by indicating it is true based only on the information the speaker currently has.
example_ar: هُوَ لَيْسَ هُنَا، عَلَى حَدِّ عِلْمِي.
example_en: He is not here, as far as I know.

en: for the purpose of training / for practice
fr: à des fins de formation / pour s'entraîner
ur: تربیت کی غرض سے / مشق کے لیے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed to develop a skill or prepare for a specific task.
example_ar: نَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِغَرَضِ التَّدْرِيبِ.
example_en: We do that for the purpose of training.

en: in the sixth place / sixthly
fr: en sixième lieu / sixièmement
ur: چھٹے نمبر پر / سادساً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the sixth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّادِسِ، الخَاتِمَةُ.
example_en: And sixthly, the conclusion.

en: leaving no room for fear / reassuringly
fr: de manière rassurante / sans laisser de place à la peur
ur: جس میں خوف کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a situation or plan that is so secure and well-managed that it removes any anxiety.
example_ar: شَرَحَ الخُطَّةَ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلخَوْفِ.
example_en: He explained the plan leaving no room for fear.

en: hard to reach / inaccessible
fr: difficile à atteindre / inaccessible
ur: جس تک پہنچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a place, person, or goal that is physically or figuratively distant or protected.
example_ar: هَذَا المَكَانُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ الوُصُولُ إِلَيْهِ.
example_en: This place is hard to reach.

en: in this situation / in this predicament
fr: dans cette situation / dans cette position
ur: اس صورتحال میں / اس موقف پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the specific circumstances or the ethical/practical standing a person finds themselves in.
example_ar: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ فِي هَذَا المَوْقِفِ؟
example_en: What do you do in this situation?

en: without my knowledge / behind my back
fr: à mon insu / sans que je le sache
ur: میری لاعلمی میں / میری اجازت کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed without the speaker being aware of it or giving consent.
example_ar: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِدُونِ عِلْمِي.
example_en: He did that without my knowledge.

en: in the short term / in the near future
fr: à court terme / dans un avenir proche
ur: مختصر مدت میں / جلد ہی
definition_en: Phrase referring to the period of time that is about to happen or will occur very soon.
example_ar: نَتَوَقَّعُ نَتَائِجَ فِي المَدَى القَرِيبِ.
example_en: We expect results in the short term.

en: regardless of age
fr: quel que soit l'âge
ur: عمر سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action, rule, or opportunity applies to everyone irrespective of how old they are.
example_ar: الرِّيَاضَةُ مُفِيدَةٌ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ العُمْرِ.
example_en: Sports are beneficial regardless of age.

en: at the head of / in charge of / at the top of
fr: à la tête de / au sommet de
ur: کے سربراہ کے طور پر / کی چوٹی پر
definition_en: Prepositional phrase indicating leadership of a group or physical position at the peak of something.
example_ar: هُوَ عَلَى رَأْسِ العَمَلِ.
example_en: He is in charge of (at the head of) the work.

en: at the sole discretion of the management
fr: à la seule discrétion de la direction
ur: انتظامیہ کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Formal phrase indicating that a decision lies entirely with the governing body of an organization.
example_ar: القَرَارُ يَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ الإِدَارَةِ.
example_en: The decision is at the sole discretion of the management.

en: in the final analysis / ultimately
fr: en fin de compte / au bout du compte
ur: حتمی نتیجے میں / آخرکار
definition_en: Phrase used to describe the absolute final result after all inputs and factors have been summed up.
example_ar: فِي المَحَصِّلَةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ، نَحْنُ الفَائِزُونَ.
example_en: In the final analysis, we are the winners.

en: year-round / throughout the year
fr: toute l'année / tout au long de l'année
ur: سارا سال / سال بھر
definition_en: Temporal phrase indicating that something happens or is available continuously through all four seasons.
example_ar: الفَاكِهَةُ مَوْجُودَةٌ عَلَى مَدَارِ السَّنَةِ.
example_en: Fruit is available year-round.

en: for the purpose of entertainment / for fun
fr: pour se divertir / pour s'amuser
ur: تفریح کی غرض سے / کھیل کود کے لیے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed for enjoyment rather than a serious or professional goal.
example_ar: نَلْعَبُ بِغَرَضِ التَّسْلِيَةِ.
example_en: We play for the purpose of entertainment.

en: in the seventh place / seventhly
fr: en septième lieu / septièmement
ur: ساتویں نمبر پر / سابعاً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the seventh item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّابِعِ، المِيزَانِيَّةُ.
example_en: And seventhly, the budget.

en: indisputable / leaving no room for protest
fr: incontestable / ne laissant aucune place à la protestation
ur: جس پر کوئی احتجاج نہ کیا جا سکے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a decision or fact that is so clearly fair or true that it cannot be argued against.
example_ar: كَانَ الحُكْمُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلاحْتِجَاجِ.
example_en: The judgment was indisputable.

en: hard to bear / unbearable
fr: difficile à supporter / insupportable
ur: جسے برداشت کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe physical pain, emotional distress, or a situation that is extremely taxing.
example_ar: هَذَا الوَجَعُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَحَمُّلُهُ.
example_en: This pain is hard to bear.

en: in this field / in this area of expertise
fr: dans ce domaine / dans ce secteur
ur: اس شعبے میں / اس میدان میں
definition_en: Phrase used to link a statement to a specific professional or academic domain.
example_ar: هُوَ خَبِيرٌ فِي هَذَا المَجَالِ.
example_en: He is an expert in this field.

en: for free / without return / without payment
fr: gratuitement / sans contrepartie
ur: بغیر کسی معاوضے کے / مفت میں
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is performed or an item is given without expecting anything in exchange.
example_ar: سَاعَدَنِي بِدُونِ مُقَابِلٍ.
example_en: He helped me without return.

en: in the medium and long term
fr: à moyen et long terme
ur: درمیانی اور طویل مدت میں
definition_en: Phrase describing strategies or effects that are expected to unfold over several years into the future.
example_ar: الخُطَّةُ تَهْدِفُ لِلنَّجَاحِ فِي المَدَى المَتَوَسِّطِ وَالبَعِيدِ.
example_en: The plan aims for success in the medium and long term.

en: regardless of nationality
fr: quelle que soit la nationalité
ur: قومیت سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a rule or opportunity is open to everyone no matter which country they belong to.
example_ar: القَبُولُ مُتَاحٌ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الجِنْسِيَّةِ.
example_en: Admission is available regardless of nationality.

en: on board (a ship, plane, or train)
fr: à bord de
ur: (جہاز یا ٹرین) کے سوار
definition_en: Prepositional phrase used specifically for being inside or on a large transport vehicle.
example_ar: كَانَ عَلَى مَتْنِ السَّفِينَةِ.
example_en: He was on board the ship.

en: by absolute pure chance
fr: par pur et simple hasard
ur: محض خالص اتفاق سے
definition_en: Double emphatic phrase emphasizing that something occurred with zero planning or expectation.
example_ar: اِلْتَقَيْنَا بِمَحْضِ صُدْفَةٍ بَحْتَةٍ.
example_en: We met by absolute pure chance.

en: in case of doubt / if you have any doubts
fr: en cas de doute / si vous avez un doute
ur: شک کی صورت میں
definition_en: Phrase used to provide instructions on what to do if the listener is unsure about a fact or a situation.
example_ar: اِسْأَلِ الطَّبِيبَ فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ شَكٍّ.
example_en: Ask the doctor in case of doubt.

en: over the decades
fr: au fil des décennies
ur: دہائیوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe long-term historical or social shifts spanning several ten-year periods.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَ العَالَمُ عَلَى مَدَى العُقُودِ.
example_en: The world changed over the decades.

en: in the eighth place / eighthly
fr: en huitième lieu / huitièmement
ur: آٹھویں نمبر پر / ثامناً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the eighth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّامِنِ، المَوْقِعُ.
example_en: And eighthly, the location.

en: beyond suspicion / leaving no room for doubts
fr: sans l'ombre d'un doute / au-dessus de tout soupçon
ur: جس میں شکوک کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: (Similar to 'la yada'u majalan lil-shakk'). Strong emphatic phrase asserting absolute innocence or truth.
example_ar: كَانَ بَرِيئًا بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلشُّكُوكِ.
example_en: He was innocent beyond suspicion.

en: hard to avoid / difficult to escape
fr: difficile à éviter / difficile d'y échapper
ur: جس سے بچنا / پیچھا چھڑانا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an obstacle, a mistake, or a consequence that is almost certain to be encountered.
example_ar: هَذَا الخَطَأُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِيهِ.
example_en: This mistake is hard to avoid.

en: in this timeframe / within this period
fr: dans ce délai / dans cette période
ur: اس وقت کے دائرہ کار میں / اس مدت میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the temporal limits within which an action must be completed.
example_ar: يَجِبُ الاِنْتِهَاءُ فِي هَذَا الإِطَارِ الزَّمَنِيِّ.
example_en: Completion must be within this timeframe.

en: without reservation / unreservedly / wholeheartedly
fr: sans réserve / sans retenue
ur: بغیر کسی تحفظ کے / کھلے دل سے
definition_en: Phrase used when giving support, agreement, or an opinion fully and without any hidden doubts or conditions.
example_ar: وَافَقَ عَلَى الخُطَّةِ بِدُونِ تَحَفُّظٍ.
example_en: He agreed to the plan without reservation.

en: in the very near future / imminently
fr: dans un avenir très proche / imminemment
ur: بہت ہی قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: Emphatic phrase referring to an event that is almost certain to happen in the coming days or weeks.
example_ar: سَنَرَى التَّغْيِيرَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ جِدًّا.
example_en: We will see the change in the very near future.

en: regardless of affiliation / regardless of belonging
fr: quelle que soit l'appartenance / sans distinction d'affiliation
ur: وابستگی سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or rule is unbiased toward a person's political, religious, or social groups.
example_ar: الخِدْمَةُ لِلْجَمِيعِ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِنْتِمَاءِ.
example_en: Service is for everyone regardless of affiliation.

en: increasingly / more and more
fr: de plus en plus / de manière croissante
ur: تیزی سے بڑھتے ہوئے / مسلسل اضافے کے ساتھ
definition_en: Adverbial phrase describing a trend or condition that is becoming more common or intense over time.
example_ar: يَتَطَوَّرُ العَالَمُ عَلَى نَحْوٍ مُتَزَايِدٍ.
example_en: The world is developing increasingly.

en: at the judge's sole discretion
fr: à la seule discrétion du juge
ur: جج کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Legal phrase indicating that the final decision in a court case rests entirely with the judge's evaluation.
example_ar: العُقُوبَةُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ القَاضِي.
example_en: The penalty is at the judge's sole discretion.

en: in case of inability to reach / if unreachable
fr: en cas d'impossibilité d'accès / si inaccessible
ur: پہنچنا ناممکن ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing an alternative plan if a person or a destination cannot be accessed.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِالمَكْتَبِ فِي حَالِ تَعَذُّرِ الوُصُولِ.
example_en: Call the office in case of inability to reach (me).

en: over the centuries
fr: à travers les siècles
ur: صدیوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing shifts or developments spanning hundreds of years.
example_ar: تَطَوَّرَتِ اللُّغَةُ عَلَى مَدَى القُرُونِ.
example_en: The language evolved over the centuries.

en: in the ninth place / ninthly
fr: en neuvième lieu / neuvièmement
ur: نویں نمبر پر / تاسعاً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the ninth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ التَّاسِعِ، الجَوْدَةُ.
example_en: And ninthly, the quality.

en: non-negotiable / leaving no room for discussion
fr: non négociable / indiscutable
ur: جس پر کسی بحث کی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a rule, decision, or fact that is final and not open to further talk.
example_ar: القَرَارُ نِهَائِيٌّ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلنِّقَاشِ.
example_en: The decision is final, leaving no room for discussion.

en: a short while ago / recently
fr: il y a peu de temps / récemment
ur: تھوڑی دیر پہلے / حال ہی میں
definition_en: Temporal phrase referring to the immediate past.
example_ar: وَصَلَ مِنْ فَتْرَةٍ قَصِيرَةٍ.
example_en: He arrived a short while ago.

en: on an environmental scale / ecologically
fr: à l'échelle environnementale / écologiquement
ur: ماحولیاتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing factors or policies that impact the ecosystem and the natural world.
example_ar: التَّأْثِيرُ وَاضِحٌ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ بِيئِيٍّ.
example_en: The impact is clear on an environmental scale.

en: in this difficult circumstance / in this predicament
fr: dans cette situation difficile / dans ces circonstances difficiles
ur: اس مشکل صورتحال میں / اس کڑے وقت میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the challenging and taxing nature of the current situation.
example_ar: نَحْتَاجُ لِلصَّبْرِ فِي هَذَا الظَّرْفِ الصَّعْبِ.
example_en: We need patience in this difficult circumstance.

en: in the very near future
fr: dans un avenir très proche
ur: بہت ہی قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Similar to 'al-manzur jiddan'). Emphatic phrase referring to an event expected almost immediately.
example_ar: سَنَعْلَمُ الحَقِيقَةَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ.
example_en: We will know the truth in the very near future.

en: regardless of orientation / regardless of direction
fr: quelle que soit l'orientation / sans distinction de tendance
ur: رجحان سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or principle is neutral toward political or personal inclinations.
example_ar: نَحْتَرِمُ الجَمِيعَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّوَجُّهِ.
example_en: We respect everyone regardless of orientation.

en: gradually / step by step
fr: graduellement / petit à petit
ur: بتدریج / رفتہ رفتہ
definition_en: Adverbial phrase describing a change or process that happens slowly and in ordered stages.
example_ar: تَتَحَسَّنُ الصِّحَّةُ عَلَى نَحْوٍ تَدْرِيجِيٍّ.
example_en: Health improves gradually.

en: at the expert's sole discretion
fr: à la seule discrétion de l'expert
ur: ماہر کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final technical judgment rests entirely with a qualified professional.
example_ar: النَّتِيجَةُ تَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ الخَبِيرِ.
example_en: The result is at the expert's sole discretion.

en: in case more is requested / if more is needed
fr: au cas où davantage serait demandé / si besoin est
ur: مزید طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for providing additional information, items, or effort if asked.
example_ar: أَنَا جَاهِزٌ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ المَزِيدِ.
example_en: I am ready in case more is requested.

en: over the generations
fr: au fil des générations
ur: نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe knowledge, traditions, or physical changes passed from parents to children over long periods.
example_ar: اِنْتَقَلَتِ القِصَّةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ.
example_en: The story was passed down over the generations.

en: in the tenth place / tenthly
fr: en dixième lieu / dixièmement
ur: دسویں نمبر پر / عاشراً
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the tenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ العَاشِرِ، الخَاتِمَةُ.
example_en: And tenthly, the conclusion.

en: inseparable / leaving no room for separation
fr: inséparable / ne laissant aucune place à la séparation
ur: جس میں علیحدگی کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe two concepts, entities, or people that are so tightly bound that they cannot be considered apart.
example_ar: الحَقِيقَةُ وَالعَدْلُ مُرْتَبِطَانِ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْفِصَالِ.
example_en: Truth and justice are linked inseparably.

en: hard to imagine / inconceivable
fr: difficile à imaginer / inconcevable
ur: جس کا تصور کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a concept, a scenario, or a future state that is so different from reality that it is hard to grasp mentally.
example_ar: العَالَمُ بِدُونِ تِكْنُولُوجْيَا مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَخَيُّلُهُ.
example_en: A world without technology is hard to imagine.

en: on an urban scale / city-wide
fr: à l'échelle urbaine / au niveau de la ville
ur: شہری سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing factors, policies, or developments that impact a city or metropolitan area.
example_ar: التَّخْطِيطُ يَتِمُّ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ حَضَرِيٍّ.
example_en: Planning is done on an urban scale.

en: in this current situation / in the status quo
fr: dans la situation actuelle / dans le statu quo
ur: اس موجودہ صورتحال میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the reality of the existing state of affairs at the present time.
example_ar: يَصْعُبُ التَّغْيِيرُ فِي هَذَا الوَضْعِ الرَّاهِنِ.
example_en: Change is difficult in this status quo.

en: without discrimination / indiscriminately / equally
fr: sans discrimination / sans distinction
ur: بغیر کسی امتیاز کے / بلا تفریق
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment, law, or opportunity is applied to everyone with absolute equality.
example_ar: نُسَاعِدُ الجَمِيعَ بِدُونِ تَمْيِيزٍ.
example_en: We help everyone without discrimination.

en: in the foreseeable future
fr: dans un avenir prévisible
ur: قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Similar to 'al-mada al-manzur'). Refers to the time period that can be reasonably predicted based on current data.
example_ar: لَا نَرَى أَيَّ مُشْكِلَةٍ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ المُسْتَقْبَلِيِّ.
example_en: We don't see any problem in the foreseeable future.

en: regardless of religion
fr: quelle que soit la religion / sans distinction de culte
ur: مذہب سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or principle is neutral toward a person's religious beliefs or faith.
example_ar: الحُقُوقُ مَضْمُونَةٌ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الدِّينِ.
example_en: Rights are guaranteed regardless of religion.

en: close to being realized / near fulfillment
fr: sur le point de se réaliser / proche de l'accomplissement
ur: حقیقت بننے کے قریب / پورا ہونے کے نزدیک
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a goal, dream, or project is very close to actually happening or being completed.
example_ar: الحُلْمُ عَلَى مَقْرُبَةٍ مِنَ التَّحَقُّقِ.
example_en: The dream is close to being realized.

en: at the public's sole discretion / up to the audience
fr: à la seule discrétion du public / au jugement du public
ur: عوام کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the success or final judgment of something depends entirely on how the general public evaluates it.
example_ar: النَّجَاحُ يَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ الجُمْهُورِ.
example_en: Success is at the public's sole discretion.

en: in case the plan changes / if the plan is modified
fr: en cas de modification du plan / si le plan change
ur: منصوبہ تبدیل ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when the original strategy or schedule is altered.
example_ar: أَعْلِمْنِي فِي حَالِ تَغَيُّرِ الخُطَّةِ.
example_en: Let me know in case the plan changes.

en: over the course of married life
fr: au cours de la vie conjugale
ur: ازدواجی زندگی کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing events or changes that happen during the duration of a marriage.
example_ar: تَعَاوَنَا عَلَى مَدَى الحَيَاةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ.
example_en: They cooperated over the course of married life.

en: in the eleventh place / eleventhly
fr: en onzième lieu / onzièmement
ur: گیارہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the eleventh item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الحَادِي عَشَرَ، المَكَانُ.
example_en: And eleventhly, the place.

en: unforgettable / leaving no room for forgetting
fr: inoubliable / ne laissant aucune place à l'oubli
ur: جسے کبھی فراموش نہ کیا جا سکے
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an event, person, or lesson so impactful that it remains permanently in the memory.
example_ar: كَانَتْ ذِكْرَى بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلنِّسْيَانِ.
example_en: It was an unforgettable memory.

en: from that moment / instantly
fr: dès cet instant / instantanément
ur: اسی لمحے سے / فوراً
definition_en: Temporal phrase indicating that an action started immediately after a specific event.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ لَحْظَتِهَا.
example_en: Everything changed from that moment.

en: hard to define / difficult to specify
fr: difficile à définir / difficile à préciser
ur: جس کی وضاحت / تعین کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a concept, a quantity, or a location that is vague or hard to pinpoint exactly.
example_ar: مَكَانُ الحَادِثِ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَحْدِيدُهُ.
example_en: The location of the accident is hard to specify.

en: in this crisis / during this emergency
fr: dans cette crise / pendant cette urgence
ur: اس بحران میں / اس ہنگامی صورتحال میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the critical and dangerous nature of the current time period.
example_ar: يَجِبُ التَّعَاوُنُ فِي هَذِهِ الأَزْمَةِ.
example_en: Cooperation is necessary in this crisis.

en: undisputed / without a rival / unrivaled
fr: sans conteste / sans rival / incontesté
ur: بلا مقابلہ / جس کا کوئی حریف نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a winner, a leader, or a truth that is so superior that no one can challenge it.
example_ar: هُوَ البَطَلُ بِدُونِ مُنَازِعٍ.
example_en: He is the undisputed champion.

en: in the very immediate future
fr: dans un avenir très immédiat
ur: انتہائی قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Refers to something happening in the next few moments or hours.
example_ar: سَنَنْطَلِقُ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ جِدًّا.
example_en: We will set off in the very immediate future.

en: regardless of position / regardless of rank
fr: quel que soit le poste / sans distinction de grade
ur: عہدے سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a rule or treatment applies to everyone no matter their job title or authority level.
example_ar: القَانُونُ يُطَبَّقُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ المَنْصِبِ.
example_en: The law is applied regardless of position.

en: suddenly / unexpectedly
fr: soudainement / de manière inattendue
ur: اچانک / ناگہانی طور پر
definition_en: Adverbial phrase describing an event that happens without prior warning or preparation.
example_ar: تَوَقَّفَ القِطَارُ عَلَى نَحْوٍ مُفَاجِئٍ.
example_en: The train stopped suddenly.

en: at the sole discretion of the authorities
fr: à la seule discrétion des autorités
ur: حکام کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Formal phrase indicating that a decision lies entirely with the government or official bodies.
example_ar: المَنْعُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ السُّلُطَاتِ.
example_en: The ban is at the sole discretion of the authorities.

en: in the event of damage / if harm occurs
fr: en cas de dommage / si un préjudice survient
ur: نقصان ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions or insurance for when physical or financial harm happens.
example_ar: سَنُعَوِّضُكَ فِي حَالِ وُقُوعِ ضَرَرٍ.
example_en: We will compensate you in the event of damage.

en: over consecutive days
fr: pendant plusieurs jours consécutifs
ur: مسلسل کئی دنوں تک
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe an action that repeats or continues without a break for several days.
example_ar: اِسْتَمَرَّ المَطَرُ عَلَى مَدَى أَيَّامٍ مُتَتَالِيَةٍ.
example_en: Rain continued over consecutive days.

en: in the twelfth place / twelfthly
fr: en douzième lieu / douzièmement
ur: بارہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twelfth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّانِي عَشَرَ، المَوَادُّ.
example_en: And twelfthly, the materials.

en: perfect / leaving no room for complaint
fr: irréprochable / sans aucune raison de se plaindre
ur: جس میں شکایت کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a service, product, or action that is of such high quality that no one can find a fault.
example_ar: كَانَتِ الخِدْمَةُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلشَّكْوَى.
example_en: The service was perfect (leaving no room for complaint).

en: such as / like / in the nature of
fr: tel que / de la nature de
ur: کی طرح / کی قسم کا
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action or statement under a specific type or class.
example_ar: هَذَا العَمَلُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُزَاحِ.
example_en: This act is in the nature of a joke.

en: hard to justify / inexcusable
fr: difficile à justifier / injustifiable
ur: جس کا جواز پیش کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action, decision, or mistake that lacks a logical or ethical reason.
example_ar: هَذَا العُنْفُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَبْرِيرُهُ.
example_en: This violence is hard to justify.

en: in this exceptional circumstance / in this unique situation
fr: dans cette circonstance exceptionnelle
ur: اس غیر معمولی صورتحال میں
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a situation that is rare, unique, and requires special rules or handling.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ بِجِدٍّ فِي هَذَا الظَّرْفِ الاسْتِثْنَائِيِّ.
example_en: We work hard in this exceptional circumstance.

en: without details / briefly
fr: sans détails / brièvement
ur: تفصیلات کے بغیر / مختصر طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used when a summary is given without going into the specific points or data.
example_ar: أَخْبِرْنِي بِالقِصَّةِ بِدُونِ تَفَاصِيلَ.
example_en: Tell me the story without details.

en: in the expected foreseeable future
fr: dans un avenir prévisible et attendu
ur: متوقع قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to the time period that is both predictable and specifically anticipated by stakeholders.
example_ar: سَنَرَى النَّجَاحَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ المُتَوَقَّعِ.
example_en: We will see success in the expected foreseeable future.

en: regardless of the past
fr: quel que soit le passé / sans tenir compte du passé
ur: ماضی سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a current decision or relationship should not be influenced by previous events or mistakes.
example_ar: سَنَبْدَأُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ المَاضِي.
example_en: We will start anew regardless of the past.

en: at your own personal discretion
fr: à votre seule discrétion personnelle
ur: آپ کی اپنی ذاتی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that the decision rests entirely with the individual's own judgment and feelings.
example_ar: الأَمْرُ يَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ الشَّخْصِيِّ.
example_en: The matter is at your own personal discretion.

en: if you are asked to do so
fr: si on vous le demande
ur: اگر آپ سے ایسا کرنے کو کہا جائے
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for an action that depends on a future request or command.
example_ar: اِفْعَلْهُ فَقَطْ فِي حَالِ طُلِبَ مِنْكَ ذَلِكَ.
example_en: Do it only if you are asked to do so.

en: over a few weeks
fr: sur quelques semaines
ur: چند ہفتوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a process or period that lasts for a short number of seven-day intervals.
example_ar: سَيَنْتَهِي العَمَلُ عَلَى مَدَى أَسَابِيعَ قَلِيلَةٍ.
example_en: The work will finish over a few weeks.

en: in the thirteenth place / thirteenthly
fr: en treizième lieu / treizièmement
ur: تیرہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّالِثِ عَشَرَ، الأَمْنُ.
example_en: And thirteenthly, security.

en: foolproof / zero-risk / leaving no room for loss
fr: sans aucun risque de perte / infaillible
ur: جس میں نقصان کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a plan or investment so secure that failure or financial loss is considered impossible.
example_ar: صَمَّمْنَا الخُطَّةَ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلخَسَارَةِ.
example_en: We designed the plan leaving no room for loss.

en: by way of coincidence / coincidentally
fr: par coïncidence / par hasard
ur: محض اتفاقاً / اتفاقیہ طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an event as being unplanned or accidental.
example_ar: حَدَثَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المِصَادَفَةِ.
example_en: That happened by way of coincidence.

en: hard to criticize / beyond reproach
fr: difficile à critiquer / irréprochable
ur: جس پر تنقید کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a piece of work, an argument, or a person so solid or perfect that finding faults is difficult.
example_ar: هَذَا المَقَالُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ نَقْدُهُ.
example_en: This article is hard to criticize.

en: in these harsh conditions / in this severe situation
fr: dans ces conditions difficiles / dans ces circonstances rudes
ur: ان سخت حالات میں
definition_en: Phrase used to describe living or working in environments that are physically or emotionally extremely demanding.
example_ar: هُمْ يَعِيشُونَ فِي هَذِهِ الظُّرُوفِ القَاسِيَةِ.
example_en: They live in these harsh conditions.

en: unconditionally / without strings attached
fr: sans condition / inconditionnellement
ur: بلا قید و شرط
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase used when an agreement, support, or surrender is made without asking for anything in return.
example_ar: نُحِبُّكَ بِدُونِ قَيْدٍ أَوْ شَرْطٍ.
example_en: We love you unconditionally.

en: in the long-term foreseeable future
fr: dans un avenir prévisible à long terme
ur: طویل مدتی قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to shifts or events that are predicted to happen many years from now based on current trends.
example_ar: سَنَرَى التَّأْثِيرَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ البَعِيدِ.
example_en: We will see the impact in the long-term foreseeable future.

en: on the verge of finishing / nearly done
fr: sur le point de se terminer / presque fini
ur: ختم ہونے کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an action or project that is in its very last moments before completion.
example_ar: العَمَلُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الاِنْتِهَاءِ.
example_en: The work is on the verge of finishing.

en: at the sole discretion of the jury / judging panel
fr: à la seule discrétion du jury
ur: منصفین (جیوری) کی اپنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Formal phrase indicating that the final decision in a competition or evaluation rests entirely with the appointed judges.
example_ar: الفَوْزُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِ لَجْنَةِ التَّحْكِيمِ.
example_en: Winning is at the sole discretion of the jury.

en: in the event of a dispute / if a disagreement occurs
fr: en cas de litige / si un désaccord survient
ur: اختلاف ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Phrase used in contracts or agreements to provide a resolution path if the parties disagree later.
example_ar: نَلْجَأُ لِلقَضَاءِ فِي حَالِ حُدُوثِ خِلافٍ.
example_en: We resort to the judiciary in the event of a dispute.

en: over the course of professional life
fr: au cours de la vie professionnelle
ur: عملی / پیشہ ورانہ زندگی کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing the span of a person's career or work experience.
example_ar: تَعَلَّمَ الكَثِيرَ عَلَى مَدَى الحَيَاةِ العَمَلِيَّةِ.
example_en: He learned a lot over the course of professional life.

en: in the fourteenth place / fourteenthly
fr: en quatorzième lieu / quatorzièmement
ur: چودہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the fourteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الرَّابِعَ عَشَرَ، التَّوْزِيعُ.
example_en: And fourteenthly, the distribution.

en: secure / tamper-proof / leaving no room for fraud
fr: sécurisé / inviolable / sans faille contre la fraude
ur: جس میں دھوکہ دہی کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a financial or digital system so secure that it prevents any deceptive manipulation.
example_ar: صَمَّمْنَا النِّظَامَ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلاحْتِيَالِ.
example_en: We designed the system leaving no room for fraud.

en: out of curiosity / just to know
fr: par curiosité
ur: محض تجسس کی بنا پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an inquiry or action as being motivated only by a desire for knowledge, not for a specific use.
example_ar: سَأَلْتُ فَقَطْ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ الفُضُولِ.
example_en: I asked just out of curiosity.

en: hard to overcome / difficult to surpass
fr: difficile à surmonter / difficile à dépasser
ur: جس سے آگے نکلنا / قابو پانا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an obstacle that is extremely resilient or a record that is very hard to beat.
example_ar: هَذَا الرَّقْمُ القِيَاسِيُّ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَجَاوُزُهُ.
example_en: This record is hard to surpass.

en: at this critical stage / at this turning point
fr: à ce stade critique / à ce tournant décisif
ur: اس نازک مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the current point in time is high-stakes and requires extremely careful decision-making.
example_ar: نَحْنُ الآنَ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ الحَرِجَةِ.
example_en: We are now at this critical stage.

en: in the extremely immediate future
fr: dans un avenir très, très proche
ur: انتہائی قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Quadruple emphatic). Refers to something happening in the next few seconds or minutes.
example_ar: سَنَعْرِفُ النَّتِيجَةَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ لِلْغَايَةِ.
example_en: We will know the result in the extremely immediate future.

en: regardless of the financial costs
fr: quel qu'en soit le coût financier
ur: مالی اخراجات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken irrespective of the money required to achieve it.
example_ar: سَنُكْمِلُ المَشْرُوعَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّكَالِيفِ المَالِيَّةِ.
example_en: We will complete the project regardless of the financial costs.

en: comprehensively / thoroughly / across the board
fr: de manière exhaustive / globalement
ur: جامع طور پر / مکمل طریقے سے
definition_en: Adverbial phrase describing an action that covers all aspects or parts of a subject without exception.
example_ar: بَحَثْنَا المَوْضُوعَ عَلَى نَحْوٍ شَامِلٍ.
example_en: We researched the subject comprehensively.

en: at your own academic discretion / based on your scholarly judgment
fr: à votre seule discrétion académique
ur: آپ کی اپنی علمی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in an educational or research context rests entirely with the listener's scholarly evaluation.
example_ar: القَرَارُ يَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ الأَكَادِيمِيِّ.
example_en: The decision is at your own academic discretion.

en: in the event of any conflict / if there is any contradiction
fr: en cas de conflit / s'il y a une contradiction
ur: کسی بھی قسم کے ٹکراؤ (تضاد) کی صورت میں
definition_en: Phrase used in legal or technical documents to provide priority rules if two statements or systems clash.
example_ar: اِرْجِعْ لِلأَصْلِ فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ أَيِّ تَعَارُضٍ.
example_en: Refer to the original in the event of any conflict.

en: over the coming generations
fr: au fil des générations futures
ur: آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing the long-term future and the legacy that will be left for children and grandchildren.
example_ar: سَيَبْقَى الأَثَرُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ القَادِمَةِ.
example_en: The impact will remain over the coming generations.

en: in the fifteenth place / fifteenthly
fr: en quinzième lieu / quinzièmement
ur: پندرہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the fifteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الخَامِسَ عَشَرَ، النَّتِيجَةُ.
example_en: And fifteenthly, the result.

en: clear / explicit / leaving no room for guesswork
fr: clair et net / ne laissant aucune place à la conjecture
ur: جس میں قیاس آرائی کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe information or a situation so obvious and well-documented that no guessing is required to understand it.
example_ar: هُوَ مَذْكُورٌ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّخْمِينِ.
example_en: It is mentioned leaving no room for guesswork.

en: in this rare case / in this exceptional instance
fr: dans ce cas rare / dans cette instance exceptionnelle
ur: اس نادر صورتحال میں / اس شاذ و نادر صورت میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the infrequent and uncommon nature of the current scenario.
example_ar: القَانُونُ يَتَغَيَّرُ فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ النَّادِرَةِ.
example_en: The law changes in this rare case.

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ جِدًّا لِلْغَايَةِ
en: in the most immediate future possible
fr: dans l'avenir le plus immédiat possible
ur: انتہائی قریب ترین ممکنہ مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Pental emphatic). Refers to something happening almost instantly or in the very next heartbeat.
example_ar: سَنَنْطَلِقُ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ جِدًّا لِلْغَايَةِ.
example_en: We will set off in the most immediate future possible.

en: regardless of ethnic differences
fr: quelles que soient les différences ethniques
ur: نسلی اختلافات سے قطع نظر
