definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or principle is neutral toward a person's race, ethnicity, or background.
example_ar: الجَمِيعُ سَوَاسِيَةٌ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِخْتِلافَاتِ العِرْقِيَّةِ.
example_en: Everyone is equal regardless of ethnic differences.

en: politically / in a political manner
fr: politiquement / de manière politique
ur: سیاسی لحاظ سے / سیاسی طور پر
definition_en: Adverbial phrase describing an action or viewpoint that is motivated by or related to governance, power, or policy.
example_ar: المَشْرُوعُ تَمَّ عَلَى نَحْوٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ.
example_en: The project was done in a political manner.

en: in the event of any shortage / if anything is missing
fr: en cas de manque / s'il manque quelque chose
ur: کسی بھی قسم کی کمی ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when resources, items, or information are found to be insufficient.
example_ar: أَعْلِمْنَا فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ أَيِّ نَقْصٍ.
example_en: Let us know in the event of any shortage.

en: over the past generations
fr: au fil des générations passées
ur: گزشتہ نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe historical trends or traditions inherited from ancestors.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَتِ القِيَمُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المَاضِيَةِ.
example_en: Values changed over the past generations.

en: in the sixteenth place / sixteenthly
fr: en seizième lieu / seizièmement
ur: سولہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the sixteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّادِسَ عَشَرَ، المِيزَانِيَّةُ.
example_en: And sixteenthly, the budget.

en: urgent / leaving no room for waiting
fr: urgent / ne laissant aucune place à l'attente
ur: جس میں انتظار کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a situation that is so critical that immediate action is required without any delay.
example_ar: الأَمْرُ عاجِلٌ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْتِظَارِ.
example_en: The matter is urgent, leaving no room for waiting.

en: by way of exaggeration / exaggeratingly
fr: par exagération
ur: مبالغہ آرائی کے طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize a statement as being hyperbolic or not strictly literal.
example_ar: هَذَا الكَلامُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُبَالَغَةِ.
example_en: This talk is by way of exaggeration.

en: hard to explain / difficult to interpret
fr: difficile à expliquer / difficile à interpréter
ur: جس کی تشریح کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a phenomenon, a behavior, or a dream that is mysterious and lacks a clear cause or meaning.
example_ar: هَذَا الشُّعُورُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفْسِيرُهُ.
example_en: This feeling is hard to explain.

en: in this difficult current circumstance
fr: dans cette situation actuelle difficile
ur: اس موجودہ مشکل صورتحال میں
definition_en: Emphatic phrase combining the currentness and the difficulty of a situation.
example_ar: نَصْمُدُ فِي هَذَا الظَّرْفِ الرَّاهِنِ الصَّعْبِ.
example_en: We persevere in this difficult current circumstance.

en: in the limited foreseeable future
fr: dans un avenir prévisible limité
ur: محدود قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to a very short and specific time window that can be predicted with accuracy.
example_ar: سَنَبْقَى هُنَا فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ المَحْدُودِ.
example_en: We will stay here in the limited foreseeable future.

en: on the brink of collapse
fr: au bord de l'effondrement
ur: تباہی کے دہانے پر / گرنے کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase describing a system, building, or person that is extremely close to falling apart or failing completely.
example_ar: النِّظَامُ عَلَى حَافَّةِ الِانْهِيَارِ.
example_en: The system is on the brink of collapse.

en: at your own professional discretion
fr: à votre seule discrétion professionnelle
ur: آپ کی اپنی پیشہ ورانہ صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in a work context rests entirely with the listener's professional experience and judgment.
example_ar: اِتَّخِذِ القَرَارَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المِهَنِيِّ.
example_en: Take the decision at your own professional discretion.

en: if the situation requires it / if necessary
fr: si la situation l'exige / si nécessaire
ur: اگر ضرورت پڑی تو / اگر معاملہ تقاضا کرے تو
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing flexibility to take an action only if and when it becomes necessary.
example_ar: سَنَتَدَخَّلُ فِي حَالِ تَطَلَّبَ الأَمْرُ ذَلِكَ.
example_en: We will intervene if the situation requires it.

en: over successive generations
fr: au fil des générations successives
ur: مسلسل آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a chain of inheritance or progress where one generation follows the next without interruption.
example_ar: سَيَنْمُو المَشْرُوعُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُتَعَاقِبَةِ.
example_en: The project will grow over successive generations.

en: in the seventeenth place / seventeenthly
fr: en dix-septième lieu / dix-septièmement
ur: سترہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the seventeenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّابِعَ عَشَرَ، التَّقْيِيمُ.
example_en: And seventeenthly, the evaluation.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْفِصَالِ التَّامِّ
en: inextricably linked / leaving no room for total separation
fr: inextricablement lié / ne laissant aucune place à une séparation totale
ur: جس میں مکمل علیحدگی کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe two issues or entities that, while different, are so connected that they cannot be fully decoupled.
example_ar: الِاقْتِصَادُ وَالسِّيَاسَةُ مُرْتَبِطَانِ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْفِصَالِ التَّامِّ.
example_en: Economy and politics are inextricably linked.

en: as a precaution / by way of caution
fr: par précaution
ur: احتیاط کے طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as being taken to prevent future problems or risks.
example_ar: أَخَذْنَا المَالُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ الحِيطَةِ.
example_en: We took the money as a precaution.

en: hard to forget / memorable
fr: difficile à oublier / mémorable
ur: جسے بھولنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an event, a face, or a lesson that stays vividly in the mind forever.
example_ar: كَانَ يَوْمًا مِنَ الصَّعْبِ نِسْيَانُهُ.
example_en: It was a day hard to forget.

en: at this decisive moment / at this fateful moment
fr: en ce moment décisif / à cet instant fatidique
ur: اس فیصلے کن لمحے میں
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the current second is when a person's entire future destiny is decided.
example_ar: اِتَّخِذْ قَرَارَكَ فِي هَذِهِ اللَّحْظَةِ المَصِيرِيَّةِ.
example_en: Take your decision at this decisive moment.

en: without any compensation / without reimbursement
fr: sans aucune compensation / sans dédommagement
ur: کسی بھی قسم کے معاوضے کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when a loss is suffered or a service is given, and no money or benefit is provided to balance it out.
example_ar: تَرَكَ العَمَلَ بِدُونِ أَيِّ تَعْوِيضٍ.
example_en: He left the work without any compensation.

en: regardless of expectations
fr: quelles que soient les attentes / indépendamment des prévisions
ur: توقعات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken irrespective of what people or data predict will happen.
example_ar: سَنَسْتَمِرُّ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّوَقُّعَاتِ.
example_en: We will continue regardless of expectations.

en: on standby / fully prepared / ready and waiting
fr: sur le qui-vive / fin prêt / en état d'alerte
ur: ہر وقت تیار / مستعد
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase describing a state of absolute readiness to act as soon as a command or signal is given.
example_ar: الجَيْشُ عَلَى أَهْبَةِ الِاسْتِعْدَادِ.
example_en: The army is on standby.

en: at your own scientific discretion
fr: à votre seule discrétion scientifique
ur: آپ کی اپنی سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Similar to academic). Phrase indicating that the final technical decision rests entirely with the listener's scientific expertise.
example_ar: النَّتِيجَةُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ.
example_en: The result is at your own scientific discretion.

en: in case of any emergency / if anything unexpected occurs
fr: en cas d'urgence / si un imprévu survient
ur: کسی بھی ہنگامی صورتحال کے پیش آنے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Phrase used to provide instructions for sudden and unplanned events that require immediate attention.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِي فِي حَالِ طُرُوءِ أَيِّ طَارِئٍ.
example_en: Call me in case of any emergency.

en: over past and current generations
fr: au fil des générations passées et présentes
ur: گزشتہ اور موجودہ نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity that spans from the ancestors into the people alive today.
example_ar: اِسْتَمَرَّتِ العَادَةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ السَّابِقَةِ وَالحَالِيَّةِ.
example_en: The custom continued over past and current generations.

en: in the eighteenth place / eighteenthly
fr: en dix-huitième lieu / dix-huitièmement
ur: اٹھارہویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the eighteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّامِنَ عَشَرَ، التَّعَاوُنُ.
example_en: And eighteenthly, the cooperation.

en: in the interest of the public / for the common good
fr: dans l'intérêt général / pour le bien commun
ur: مفادِ عامہ کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as being motivated by the benefit of society as a whole.
example_ar: هَذَا القَرَارُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ العَامَّةِ.
example_en: This decision is in the interest of the public.

en: hard to cross / difficult to surpass
fr: difficile à franchir / difficile à dépasser
ur: جس سے پار پانا / آگے نکلنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a barrier that is physically hard to cross or a record/standard that is very hard to beat.
example_ar: هَذَا الحَاجِزُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَخَطِّيهِ.
example_en: This barrier is hard to cross.

en: in this transitional phase / during this transition
fr: dans cette phase de transition
ur: اس عبوری مرحلے میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the temporary period between two stable states or regimes.
example_ar: نَحْتَاجُ لِلاِسْتِقْرَارِ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ الِانْتِقَالِيَّةِ.
example_en: We need stability in this transitional phase.

en: without censorship / without supervision / uncensored
fr: sans censure / sans surveillance
ur: بغیر کسی سنسر شپ کے / بغیر نگرانی کے
definition_en: Phrase used when information is shared or actions are taken without any filtering or oversight by an authority.
example_ar: الكِتَابُ نُشِرَ بِدُونِ رَقَابَةٍ.
example_en: The book was published without censorship.

en: regardless of religious views / observance
fr: quelles que soient les convictions religieuses
ur: مذہبی نظریات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or law applies to everyone irrespective of their religious affiliation or level of practice.
example_ar: نُطَبِّقُ العَدْلَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ المَرَاقِبِ الدِّينِيَّةِ.
example_en: We apply justice regardless of religious views.

en: on the verge of exploding / about to blow up
fr: sur le point d'exploser
ur: پھٹنے کے قریب / دھماکہ ہونے کے نزدیک
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a bomb, a volcano, or a situation (like anger or social unrest) that is about to erupt violently.
example_ar: الوَضْعُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الاِنْفِجَارِ.
example_en: The situation is on the verge of exploding.

en: at your own artistic discretion / based on your craft
fr: à votre seule discrétion artistique
ur: آپ کی اپنی فنی / فنکارانہ صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in an arts or crafts context rests entirely with the listener's creative judgment.
example_ar: اِخْتَرِ اللَّوْنَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ الفَنِّيِّ.
example_en: Choose the color at your own artistic discretion.

en: in case clarification is requested / if you need to explain
fr: en cas de demande de clarification
ur: وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener is asked to explain their actions or statements further.
example_ar: أَنَا جَاهِزٌ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ.
example_en: I am ready in case clarification is requested.

en: over successive and closely-following generations
fr: au fil des générations qui se succèdent rapidement
ur: ایک کے بعد ایک آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a rapid and continuous succession of generations, often in the context of fast-paced cultural or technological change.
example_ar: تَطَوَّرَتِ التِّكْنُولُوجْيَا عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُتَلَاحِقَةِ.
example_en: Technology evolved over successive and closely-following generations.

en: in the nineteenth place / nineteenthly
fr: en dix-neuvième lieu / dix-neuvièmement
ur: انیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the nineteenth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ التَّاسِعَ عَشَرَ، التَّوْثِيقُ.
example_en: And nineteenthly, the documentation.

en: smooth / frictionless / leaving no room for friction
fr: fluide / sans frottement / ne laissant aucune place à la friction
ur: جس میں رگڑ (ٹکراؤ) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a social or mechanical process designed so perfectly that it avoids any conflict, resistance, or physical rubbing.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ النِّظَامُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلاحْتِكَاكِ.
example_en: The system was designed leaving no room for friction.

en: on an academic research scale
fr: à une échelle de recherche académique
ur: علمی تحقیقی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing developments or standards that are based on rigorous university-level study and peer review.
example_ar: يُدْرَسُ المَوْضُوعُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ بَحْثِيٍّ أَكَادِيمِيٍّ.
example_en: The subject is studied on an academic research scale.

en: in this wasted time / in these lost moments
fr: dans ce temps perdu
ur: اس ضائع شدہ وقت میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a period that was unproductive or where an opportunity has already passed.
example_ar: لَا نَفْعَ مِنَ العَمَلِ فِي هَذَا الوَقْتِ الضَّائِعِ.
example_en: There is no use working in this wasted time.

en: in the very near and limited future
fr: dans un avenir proche et limité
ur: بہت ہی قریب اور محدود مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to a specific, short-term prediction window that is expected to end soon.
example_ar: سَنَرَى النَّتَيجَةَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَحْدُودِ.
example_en: We will see the result in the very near and limited future.

en: regardless of the repercussions / consequences
fr: quelles que soient les répercussions / conséquences
ur: نتائج (اثرات) سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken irrespective of the negative fallout or complex effects it might cause later.
example_ar: سَنَقُومُ بِذَلِكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّدَاعِيَاتِ.
example_en: We will do that regardless of the repercussions.

en: in full swing / flat out / with all effort
fr: battre son plein / à plein régime
ur: سرگرمی سے جاری / پوری طاقت کے ساتھ
definition_en: Idiomatic phrase describing a project or event that is operating at maximum intensity and speed.
example_ar: التَّحْضِيرَاتُ جَارِيَةٌ عَلَى قَدَمِ السَّاقِ.
example_en: Preparations are in full swing.

en: at your own practical discretion
fr: à votre seule discrétion pratique
ur: آپ کی اپنی عملی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in a hands-on or logistical context rests entirely with the listener's practical experience.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَمَلِيِّ.
example_en: Decide at your own practical discretion.

en: in case of any doubt / if you are unsure
fr: en cas de doute / si vous avez un doute
ur: کسی بھی قسم کے شک کی صورت میں / اگر یقین نہ ہو تو
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener feels uncertain or lacks confidence in a fact.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِي فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ أَيِّ شَكٍّ.
example_en: Call me in case of any doubt.

en: over bygone generations / across ancient times
fr: au fil des générations passées / à travers les âges révolus
ur: قدیم نسلوں کے دوران / رفتہ رفتہ گزرتی نسلوں میں
definition_en: Poetic and formal temporal phrase used to describe things that happened in the very distant, almost forgotten past.
example_ar: ضَاعَتِ القِصَصُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ الغَابِرَةِ.
example_en: Stories were lost over bygone generations.

en: in the twentieth place / twentiethly
fr: en vingtième lieu / vingtièmement
ur: بیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twentieth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ العِشْرِينَ، الخَاتِمَةُ.
example_en: And twentiethly, the conclusion.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّأْوِيلِ الخَاطِئِ
en: unambiguous / leaving no room for misinterpretation
fr: sans ambiguïté / ne laissant aucune place à une mauvaise interprétation
ur: جس میں غلط تشریح کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a statement or law so precisely worded that it cannot be twisted or misunderstood.
example_ar: كُتِبَ القَانُونُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّأْوِيلِ الخَاطِئِ.
example_en: The law was written leaving no room for misinterpretation.

en: by way of historical coincidence / a quirk of history
fr: par une coïncidence historique
ur: تاریخی اتفاق کے طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an event as being a rare and unplanned alignment of historical factors.
example_ar: هَذَا اللِّقَاءُ كَانَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُصَادَفَةِ التَّارِيخِيَّةِ.
example_en: This meeting was by way of historical coincidence.

en: hard to imagine / inconceivable
fr: difficile à imaginer / inconcevable
ur: جس کا تصور کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe something so strange, grand, or terrible that the human mind struggles to form a picture of it.
example_ar: جَمَالُ المَكَانِ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَصَوُّرُهُ.
example_en: The beauty of the place is hard to imagine.

en: in this suffocating crisis / in this dire emergency
fr: dans cette crise étouffante / dans cette situation désespérée
ur: اس گھٹن زدہ (انتہائی شدید) بحران میں
definition_en: Metaphorical phrase describing a situation so stressful and difficult that it feels like it is physically choking the person or society.
example_ar: كَيْفَ نَنْجُو فِي هَذِهِ الأَزْمَةِ الخَانِقَةِ؟
example_en: How do we survive in this suffocating crisis?

en: without prior agreement / spontaneously / unplanned
fr: sans accord préalable / spontanément
ur: کسی پیشگی معاہدے (اتفاق) کے بغیر / اچانک
definition_en: Phrase used when two or more parties do the same thing at the same time without having planned it together beforehand.
example_ar: تَقَابَلْنَا بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِتِّفَاقٍ.
example_en: We met without prior agreement.

en: in the long-term foreseeable global future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible mondial à long terme
ur: عالمی طویل مدتی قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Complex temporal). Refers to trends that will impact the entire planet over the next several decades.
example_ar: النَّتَائِجُ سَتَظْهَرُ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ العَالَمِيِّ البَعِيدِ.
example_en: Results will appear in the long-term foreseeable global future.

en: regardless of the dire consequences / disastrous results
fr: quelles que soient les graves conséquences / malgré les conséquences désastreuses
ur: انتہائی خطرناک نتائج سے قطع نظر
definition_en: High-stakes version of bi-ghadd an-nazar. Asserts that an action will proceed even if it leads to total disaster.
example_ar: سَيَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ العَوَاقِبِ الوَخِيمَةِ.
example_en: He will do that regardless of the dire consequences.

en: on the edge of the abyss / on the brink of ruin
fr: au bord du gouffre / au bord de l'abîme
ur: کھائی کے کنارے پر / بربادی کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Dramatic idiom describing a person, economy, or relationship that is one small step away from complete and total destruction.
example_ar: البَلَدُ يَقِفُ عَلَى حَافَّةِ الهَاوِيَةِ.
example_en: The country stands on the edge of the abyss.

en: at your own absolute personal discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion personnelle absolue
ur: آپ کی اپنی بالکل خالص ذاتی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Emphasizes that no one else can influence the decision; it belongs only to the individual listener.
example_ar: الأَمْرُ يَعُودُ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ الشَّخْصِيِّ المَحْضِ.
example_en: The matter rests at your own absolute personal discretion.

front: فِي حَالِ حُدُوثِ أَيِّ طَارِئٍ غَيْرِ مُتَوَقَّعٍ
en: in the event of any completely unexpected emergency
fr: en cas d'urgence tout à fait imprévue
ur: کسی بھی بالکل غیر متوقع ہنگامی صورتحال کے پیش آنے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Complex conditional phrase covering extreme and unforeseen situations.
example_ar: اِتَّبِعِ الخُطَّةَ فِي حَالِ حُدُوثِ أَيِّ طَارِئٍ غَيْرِ مُتَوَقَّعٍ.
example_en: Follow the plan in the event of any completely unexpected emergency.

en: over exceptional generations
fr: au fil des générations exceptionnelles
ur: غیر معمولی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a specific lineage or era of people who achieved greatness or faced unique challenges.
example_ar: سَيُكْتَبُ التَّارِيخُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ الِاسْتِثْنَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: History will be written over exceptional generations.

en: in the twenty-first place / twenty-firstly
fr: en vingt-et-unième lieu
ur: اکیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-first item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الحَادِي وَالعِشْرِينَ، الأَمَلُ.
example_en: And twenty-firstly, hope.

en: uninterrupted / leaving no room for interruption
fr: sans interruption / ne laissant aucune place à l'interruption
ur: جس میں تعطل (رکاوٹ) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a flow of energy, communication, or supply that is guaranteed to be constant and steady.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ المَصْنَعُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِطَاعِ.
example_en: The factory was designed leaving no room for interruption.

en: for the sake of material interest / for financial gain
fr: par intérêt matériel / pour le gain financier
ur: مادی مفاد کی خاطر / مالی فائدے کے لیے
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as being motivated by money, assets, or physical benefit rather than ethics.
example_ar: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ المَادِّيَّةِ.
example_en: He did that for the sake of material interest.

en: in this extreme emergency situation
fr: dans cette situation d'urgence extrême
ur: اس انتہائی ہنگامی صورتحال میں
definition_en: Strong emphatic phrase used for life-or-death scenarios requiring immediate high-level intervention.
example_ar: نَحْتَاجُ لِلمُسَاعَدَةِ فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ الطَّارِئَةِ القُصْوَى.
example_en: We need help in this extreme emergency situation.

en: without prior formal warning / notice
fr: sans préavis officiel / sans avertissement formel
ur: کسی پیشگی سرکاری اطلاع (وارننگ) کے بغیر
definition_en: Formal version of the term for no warning. Focuses on the lack of official paperwork or notice before an action.
example_ar: أُغْلِقَ المَحَلُّ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِنْذَارٍ رَسْمِيٍّ.
example_en: The shop was closed without prior formal warning.

en: in the near and tangible foreseeable future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche et tangible
ur: قریب اور نظر آنے والے (ٹھوس) مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to changes that are not only coming soon but will have a physical, observable impact.
example_ar: سَنَرَى التَّحَسُّنَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ.
example_en: We will see the improvement in the near and tangible foreseeable future.

en: regardless of partisan considerations / party politics
fr: quelles que soient les considérations partisanes
ur: جماعتی (پارٹی) مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision is made for the common good, ignoring the specific interests of political parties.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الحِزْبِيَّةِ.
example_en: We work regardless of partisan considerations.

en: at your own legal discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion juridique
ur: آپ کی اپنی قانونی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in a law-related context rests entirely with the listener's legal expertise.
example_ar: اِتَّخِذْ قَرَارَكَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ القَانُونِيِّ.
example_en: Take your decision at your own legal discretion.

front: فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ أَيِ تَعَارُضِ مَصَالِحَ
en: in the event of any conflict of interest
fr: en cas de conflit d'intérêts
ur: مفادات کے ٹکراؤ کی صورت میں
definition_en: Technical phrase used in business and ethics to describe when a person's private interests clash with their professional duties.
example_ar: أَفْصِحْ فِي حَالِ وُجُودِ أَيِ تَعَارُضِ مَصَالِحَ.
example_en: Disclose in the event of any conflict of interest.

en: over extremely rapid successive generations
fr: au fil des générations qui se succèdent très rapidement
ur: انتہائی تیزی سے مسلسل آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe an era where generational turnover and social change happen at a blistering pace.
example_ar: العَالَمُ يَتَغَيَّرُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُتَلاحِقَةِ جِدًّا.
example_en: The world changes over extremely rapid successive generations.

en: in the twenty-second place / twenty-secondly
fr: en vingt-deuxième lieu
ur: بائیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-second item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّانِي وَالعِشْرِينَ، الاِبْتِكَارُ.
example_en: And twenty-secondly, innovation.

en: precise / straight / leaving no room for deviation
fr: précis / droit / ne laissant aucune place à la déviation
ur: جس میں انحراف (بھٹکنے) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a guide, a machine, or a moral code so perfect that it ensures one stays exactly on the intended path.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ المَسَارُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْحِرَافِ.
example_en: The path was designed leaving no room for deviation.

en: as a matter of collective responsibility
fr: par responsabilité collective
ur: اجتماعی ذمہ داری کے طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as something everyone in a group must do together to ensure success or safety.
example_ar: الحِفَاظُ عَلَى المَاءِ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَسْؤُولِيَّةِ الجَمَاعِيَّةِ.
example_en: Saving water is a matter of collective responsibility.

en: hard to achieve / difficult to realize
fr: difficile à réaliser / difficile à atteindre
ur: جسے حاصل کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a goal, a dream, or a target that requires extreme effort and might be nearly impossible.
example_ar: هَذَا الحُلْمُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَحْقِيقُهُ.
example_en: This dream is hard to achieve.

en: at this pivotal stage / at this crucial junction
fr: à cette étape charnière / à ce stade pivot
ur: اس کلیدی (انتہائی اہم) مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the current period acts as a hinge upon which all future progress depends.
example_ar: نَحْنُ الآنَ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ.
example_en: We are now at this pivotal stage.

en: without prior personal acquaintance / knowing each other
fr: sans connaissance personnelle préalable
ur: کسی ذاتی جان پہچان کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when two people interact or a favor is done even though they have never met before.
example_ar: سَاعَدَنِي بِدُونِ سَابِقِ مَعْرِفَةٍ شَخْصِيَّةٍ.
example_en: He helped me without prior personal acquaintance.

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ جِدًّا
en: in the extremely near and tangible foreseeable future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche et très tangible
ur: بہت ہی قریب اور انتہائی ٹھوس مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Complex emphatic). Refers to physical results coming in the next few hours or days.
example_ar: سَنَجْنِي الثِّمَارَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ جِدًّا.
example_en: We will reap the fruits in the extremely near and tangible foreseeable future.

en: regardless of intellectual leanings / ideologies
fr: quelles que soient les orientations intellectuelles / idéologiques
ur: فکری نظریات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a treatment or truth is universal, ignoring what a person believes or their political/philosophical bias.
example_ar: الحَقِيقَةُ ثَابِتَةٌ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ التَّوَجُّهَاتِ الفِكْرِيَّةِ.
example_en: The truth is fixed regardless of intellectual leanings.

en: on the brink of destruction / peril
fr: au bord de la perdition / au bord du désastre
ur: ہلاکت کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Strong religious/formal idiom describing a person or group that is dangerously close to total ruin or divine punishment.
example_ar: لَا تُلْقُوا بِأَنْفُسِكُمْ عَلَى حَافَّةِ التَّهْلُكَةِ.
example_en: Do not throw yourselves onto the brink of destruction.

en: at your own absolute scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique absolue
ur: آپ کی اپنی بالکل خالص سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's specialized technical/scientific authority.
example_ar: اِعْتَمِدِ النَّتِيجَةَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ المَحْضِ.
example_en: Approve the result at your own absolute scientific discretion.

en: in case technical support is requested / needed
fr: en cas de demande de support technique
ur: فنی مدد (ٹیکنیکل سپورٹ) طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a system fails or a user needs expert help with machinery or software.
example_ar: اِتَّصِلْ بِنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ الدَّعْمِ الفَنِّيِّ.
example_en: Contact us in case technical support is requested.

en: over extremely exceptional generations
fr: au fil des générations extrêmement exceptionnelles
ur: انتہائی غیر معمولی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a unique lineage or era of people who achieved legendary greatness or faced world-changing challenges.
example_ar: سَيُكْتَبُ التَّارِيخُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ الِاسْتِثْنَائِيَّةِ جِدًّا.
example_en: History will be written over extremely exceptional generations.

en: in the twenty-third place / twenty-thirdly
fr: en vingt-troisième lieu
ur: تیئیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-third item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّالِثِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الاِسْتِمْرَارُ.
example_en: And twenty-thirdly, the continuation.

en: stable / unshakeable / leaving no room for reversal / overthrow
fr: stable / inébranlable / ne laissant aucune place au renversement
ur: جس میں الٹنے (بغاوت) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a regime, a decision, or a physical structure so secure that it cannot be overturned or reversed.
example_ar: ثُبِّتَ الحُكْمُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِلابِ.
example_en: The rule was secured leaving no room for reversal.

en: as a matter of individual responsibility
fr: par responsabilité individuelle
ur: انفرادی ذمہ داری کے طور پر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as something each single person must do themselves, not relying on the group.
example_ar: الصِّحَّةُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَسْؤُولِيَّةِ الفَرْدِيَّةِ.
example_en: Health is a matter of individual responsibility.

en: hard to avoid falling into / easy to slip up
fr: difficile d'éviter d'y tomber / facile de s'y tromper
ur: جس میں پڑنے (غلطی کرنے) سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a common mistake, a trap, or a logical fallacy that many people succumb to.
example_ar: هَذَا الفَخُّ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِيهِ.
example_en: This trap is hard to avoid falling into.

front: فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ القُصْوَى مِنَ الصِّرَاعِ
en: in this extreme state of conflict
fr: dans cet état de conflit extrême
ur: تنازع (تصادم) کی اس انتہائی صورتحال میں
definition_en: Phrase indicating that a situation has reached its highest level of tension, disagreement, or physical fighting.
example_ar: نَحْتَاجُ لِلْحِكْمَةِ فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ القُصْوَى مِنَ الصِّرَاعِ.
example_en: We need wisdom in this extreme state of conflict.

en: without prior technical notice
fr: sans préavis technique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی فنی اطلاع (ٹیکنیکل نوٹس) کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used in IT or engineering when a system is shut down or changed without warning users about the technical shift.
example_ar: اِنْقَطَعَتِ الخِدْمَةُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِشْعَارٍ تَقْنِيٍّ.
example_en: Service was cut without prior technical notice.

en: in the near and perceivable foreseeable future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche et perceptible
ur: قریب اور محسوس ہونے والے مستقبل میں
definition_en: Similar to tangible. Refers to changes that will be felt by the senses or experienced in daily life very soon.
example_ar: سَيَتَغَيَّرُ الجَوُّ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَحْسُوسِ.
example_en: The atmosphere will change in the near and perceivable foreseeable future.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العِرْقِيَّةِ وَالدِّينِيَّةِ
en: regardless of ethnic and religious considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations ethniques et religieuses
ur: نسلی اور مذہبی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: (Double emphatic neutrality). Phrase asserting that a treatment is blind to both race and religion.
example_ar: العَدْلُ لِلْجَمِيعِ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العِرْقِيَّةِ وَالدِّينِيَّةِ.
example_en: Justice is for all regardless of ethnic and religious considerations.

en: on the verge of total disappearance / extinction
fr: sur le point de disparaître totalement / extinction totale
ur: مکمل طور پر غائب (ختم) ہونے کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an animal species, a language, or a tradition that is about to vanish forever.
example_ar: هَذَا الكَائِنُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الِاخْتِفَاءِ التَّامِّ.
example_en: This creature is on the verge of total disappearance.

en: at your own scientific and academic discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique et académique
ur: آپ کی اپنی سائنسی اور علمی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Double formal authority). Combines specialized research and general scholarly judgment.
example_ar: القَرَارُ لَكَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ وَالأَكَادِيمِيِّ.
example_en: The decision is yours at your own scientific and academic discretion.

en: in case an immediate update is requested
fr: en cas de demande de mise à jour immédiate
ur: فوری اپ ڈیٹ (تجدید) طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase used in software or administrative contexts requiring an instant change to the latest version.
example_ar: نَحْنُ جَاهِزُونَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّحْدِيثِ الفَوْرِيِّ.
example_en: We are ready in case an immediate update is requested.

en: in the twenty-fourth place / twenty-fourthly
fr: en vingt-quatrième lieu
ur: چوبیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-fourth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الرَّابِعِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الأَمْنُ.
example_en: And twenty-fourthly, security.

en: for the sake of strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique
ur: تزویراتی (حکمتِ عملی کے) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as being motivated by long-term planning and high-level goals.
example_ar: هَذَا التَّحَالُفُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ.
example_en: This alliance is for the sake of strategic interest.

en: at this extremely crucial pivotal stage
fr: à cette étape charnière tout à fait cruciale
ur: اس انتہائی فیصلہ کن کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Refers to a moment in time where every single choice will change the course of history.
example_ar: نَحْنُ نَعِيشُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المَفْصِلِيَّةِ الحَاسِمَةِ.
example_en: We are living at this extremely crucial pivotal stage.

en: without prior linguistic knowledge
fr: sans connaissance linguistique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی لسانی (زبان کے) علم کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when someone enters a situation involving a new language without having studied it at all.
example_ar: سَافَرَ إِلَى هُنَاكَ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ مَعْرِفَةٍ لُغَوِيَّةٍ.
example_en: He traveled there without prior linguistic knowledge.

en: in the near foreseeable global future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible mondial proche
ur: عالمی قریب ترین قابلِ پیش گوئی مستقبل میں
definition_en: Refers to international changes or trends expected to happen across the whole world within a few years.
example_ar: سَيَتَغَيَّرُ الاِقْتِصَادُ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ العَالَمِيِّ القَرِيبِ.
example_en: The economy will change in the near foreseeable global future.

en: regardless of political consequences / fallout
fr: quelles que soient les conséquences politiques
ur: سیاسی نتائج سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action will be taken even if it ruins a politician's career or causes a diplomatic crisis.
example_ar: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ العَوَاقِبِ السِّيَاسِيَّةِ.
example_en: He did that regardless of the political consequences.

en: on the edge of a crumbling cliff / on the brink of ruin (Quranic idiom)
fr: au bord d'une falaise croulante / au bord du désastre
ur: گرنے والے کنارے کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Powerful religious/literary idiom describing a situation with no solid foundation that is about to collapse completely.
example_ar: بَنَى عَمَلَهُ عَلَى شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ.
example_en: He built his work on the edge of a crumbling cliff.

en: at your own rational discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion rationnelle
ur: آپ کی اپنی عقلی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision rests with the listener's use of logic and reason.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَقْلِيِّ.
example_en: Decide at your own rational discretion.

en: in case legal clarification is requested / needed
fr: en cas de demande de clarification juridique
ur: قانونی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a lawyer or judge needs a point explained according to the law.
example_ar: نَحْنُ هُنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ القَانُونِيِّ.
example_en: We are here in case legal clarification is requested.

en: over finished / elapsed generations
fr: au fil des générations passées / révolues
ur: گزری ہوئی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Formal temporal phrase used to describe a continuity that spans generations that have completely finished their time.
example_ar: سَادَ هَذَا الفِكْرُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْصَرِمَةِ.
example_en: This thought prevailed over elapsed generations.

en: in the twenty-fifth place / twenty-fifthly
fr: en vingt-cinquième lieu
ur: پچیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-fifth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الخَامِسِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الجَوْدَةُ.
example_en: And twenty-fifthly, quality.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلشَّكِّ فِي المِصْدَاقِيَّةِ
en: beyond reproach / leaving no room for doubt in credibility
fr: irréprochable / ne laissant aucune place au doute quant à la crédibilité
ur: جس میں ساکھ (اعتبار) پر شک کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: High-level phrase used to describe evidence, a witness, or a document that is so perfect it cannot be doubted.
example_ar: أَثْبَتَ صِحَّتَهُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلشَّكِّ فِي المِصْدَاقِيَّةِ.
example_en: He proved its truth leaving no room for doubt in credibility.

en: in the supreme national interest
fr: dans l'intérêt national suprême
ur: اعلیٰ قومی مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify state-level decisions that take priority over everything else for the survival or prosperity of the country.
example_ar: هَذَا القَرَارُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الوَطَنِيَّةِ العُلْيَا.
example_en: This decision is in the supreme national interest.

en: hard to replace / irreplaceable
fr: difficile à remplacer / irremplaçable
ur: جس کا نعم البدل ملنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a person, a lost item, or an opportunity that is so unique it cannot be substituted.
example_ar: فَقْدُهُ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَعْوِيضُهُ.
example_en: Losing him was hard to replace (he was irreplaceable).

en: at this advanced developmental stage
fr: à cette phase de développement avancée
ur: اس جدید ترقیاتی مرحلے میں
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a period where a project or technology has moved past the initial basics and is now complex.
example_ar: نَحْنُ الآنَ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ التَّطْوِيرِيَّةِ المُتَقَدِّمَةِ.
example_en: We are now at this advanced developmental stage.

en: regardless of logistical facilities / arrangements
fr: quelles que soient les facilités logistiques
ur: لاجسٹک (انتظامی اور سپلائی) سہولیات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a mission or event must proceed even if the supply lines and equipment are not perfect.
example_ar: سَنَتَقَدَّمُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ المَرَافِقِ اللُّوجِسْتِيَّةِ.
example_en: We will advance regardless of logistical facilities.

en: on the verge of surrendering / giving up
fr: sur le point de se rendre / d'abandonner
ur: ہتھیار ڈالنے (ہار ماننے) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a person or an army that has fought to their limit and is about to stop resisting.
example_ar: كَانَ العَدُوُّ عَلَى حَافَّةِ الِاسْتِسْلَامِ.
example_en: The enemy was on the verge of surrendering.

en: at your own military discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion militaire
ur: آپ کی اپنی فوجی صوابدید پر
definition_en: Phrase indicating that the final decision in a tactical/war context rests entirely with the listener's military judgment.
example_ar: قُدِ الهُجُومَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَسْكَرِيِّ.
example_en: Lead the attack at your own military discretion.

en: in case rapid intervention is requested
fr: en cas de demande d'intervention rapide
ur: فوری مداخلت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase used in security or emergency management when a backup force is waiting for a signal to act.
example_ar: نَحْنُ جَاهِزُونَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّدَخُّلِ السَّرِيعِ.
example_en: We are ready in case rapid intervention is requested.

en: over exceptional and glorious generations
fr: au fil des générations exceptionnelles et glorieuses
ur: غیر معمولی اور شاندار نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe an era of people who were not only unique but also brought great honor and pride to their history.
example_ar: بَقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ الِاسْتِثْنَائِيَّةِ المَجِيدَةِ.
example_en: Remembrance remained over exceptional and glorious generations.

en: in the twenty-sixth place / twenty-sixthly
fr: en vingt-sixième lieu
ur: چھبیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-sixth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّادِسِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الكَفَاءَةُ.
example_en: And twenty-sixthly, efficiency.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّلا عُبِ
en: secure / tamper-proof / leaving no room for manipulation
fr: sécurisé / inviolable / ne laissant aucune place à la manipulation
ur: جس میں ہیر پھیر (ہیرا پھیری) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a system, an election, or data protected so well that it cannot be cheated or changed illegally.
example_ar: النِّظَامُ مُشَفَّرٌ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّلا عُبِ.
example_en: The system is encrypted leaving no room for manipulation.

en: for purely commercial interest
fr: par intérêt purement commercial
ur: محض تجارتی مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to categorize an action as being motivated only by profit and market share, without ethical or social concerns.
example_ar: القَرَارُ اِتُّخِذَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ التِّجَارِيَّةِ البَحْتَةِ.
example_en: The decision was made for purely commercial interest.

front: فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ القُصْوَى مِنَ النُّمُوِّ
en: in this extreme state of growth
fr: dans cet état de croissance extrême
ur: نشوونما (ترقی) کی اس انتہائی صورتحال میں
definition_en: Phrase describing a period of rapid, explosive expansion in economy, nature, or a child's development.
example_ar: الشَّرِكَةُ الآنَ فِي هَذِهِ الحَالَةِ القُصْوَى مِنَ النُّمُوِّ.
example_en: The company is now in this extreme state of growth.

en: without prior binding legal notice
fr: sans préavis juridique contraignant
ur: کسی پیشگی لازمی قانونی اطلاع کے بغیر
definition_en: Formal version focusing on the lack of a legally required document that mandates an action.
example_ar: تَمَّ الإِخْلاءُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِشْعَارٍ قَانُونِيٍّ مُلْزِمٍ.
example_en: Eviction happened without prior binding legal notice.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ المَالِيَّةِ الضَّخْمَةِ
en: regardless of the huge financial considerations / costs
fr: quelles que soient les considérations financières énormes
ur: بھاری مالی مفادات (اخراجات) سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a project is so important that even multi-billion dollar costs do not matter.
example_ar: سَنَسْتَمِرُّ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ المَالِيَّةِ الضَّخْمَةِ.
example_en: We will continue regardless of the huge financial considerations.

en: on the verge of brilliant success
fr: sur le point d'un succès éclatant
ur: شاندار کامیابی کے دہانے پر (قریب)
definition_en: Phrase describing a person or project that is just one step away from achieving fame and greatness.
example_ar: نَحْنُ الآنَ عَلَى وَشْكِ النَّجَاحِ البَاهِرِ.
example_en: We are now on the verge of brilliant success.

en: at your own absolute purely logical discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion purement logique
ur: آپ کی اپنی بالکل خالص منطقی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's objective reasoning, removing all emotion.
example_ar: اِحْكُمْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المَنْطِقِيِّ الصِّرْفِ.
example_en: Judge at your own absolute purely logical discretion.

en: in case additional clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification supplémentaire
ur: مزید وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a basic explanation is not enough and more details are needed.
example_ar: أَنَا جَاهِزٌ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِضَافِيِّ.
example_en: I am ready in case additional clarification is requested.

en: over victorious / triumphant generations
fr: au fil des générations victorieuses
ur: فاتح (کامیاب) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people who have consistently won their battles and maintained their pride.
example_ar: اِزْدَهَرَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْتَصِرَةِ.
example_en: The state flourished over victorious generations.

en: in the twenty-seventh place / twenty-seventhly
fr: en vingt-septième lieu
ur: ستائیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-seventh item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّابِعِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الاِسْتِقْرَارُ المَالِيُّ.
example_en: And twenty-seventhly, financial stability.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْفِجَارِ السُّكَّانِيِّ
en: preventing population explosion / leaving no room for overpopulation
fr: empêchant l'explosion démographique / ne laissant aucune place à la surpopulation
ur: جس میں آبادی کے دھماکے (بے پناہ اضافے) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe policies or urban planning designed so perfectly that they control and manage population growth safely.
example_ar: خُطِّطَتِ المَدِينَةُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْفِجَارِ السُّكَّانِيِّ.
example_en: The city was planned leaving no room for a population explosion.

en: for the sake of fleeting / temporary political interest
fr: par intérêt politique éphémère
ur: عارضی سیاسی مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to criticize an action as being motivated by short-term power gains rather than long-term vision.
example_ar: هَذَا القَانُونُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ السِّيَاسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ.
example_en: This law is for the sake of fleeting political interest.

en: hard to imagine anymore / inconceivable now
fr: difficile à imaginer désormais / inconcevable à présent
ur: جس کا اب مزید تصور کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used when a change is so permanent or a situation so evolved that the old way of being is no longer thinkable.
example_ar: العَالَمُ بِدُونِ إِنْتِرْنِت مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَخَيُّلُهُ بَعْدَ الآنَ.
example_en: The world without the internet is hard to imagine anymore.

en: at this rare and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière rare
ur: اس نایاب اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a unique moment in time that only happens once in several lifetimes.
example_ar: لَدَيْنَا فُرْصَةٌ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ النَّادِرَةِ.
example_en: We have an opportunity at this rare and pivotal stage.

en: without prior security coordination
fr: sans coordination préalable en matière de sécurité
ur: کسی پیشگی حفاظتی (سیکیورٹی) ہم آہنگی کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used in police or military contexts when an action is taken without informing other security branches beforehand.
example_ar: نُفِّذَتِ العَمَلِيَّةُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَنْسِيقٍ أَمْنِيٍّ.
example_en: The operation was executed without prior security coordination.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ الشَّخْصِيَّةِ
en: regardless of personal emotional considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations émotionnelles personnelles
ur: ذاتی جذباتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision is purely logical, ignoring feelings of love, anger, or pity.
example_ar: اِحْكُمْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ الشَّخْصِيَّةِ.
example_en: Judge regardless of personal emotional considerations.

en: on the verge of fading away / vanishing
fr: sur le point de s'évanouir / de disparaître
ur: مٹ جانے (غائب ہونے) کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase describing a sound, a memory, or a physical entity that is slowly becoming nothing.
example_ar: الأَمَلُ عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّلاشِي.
example_en: Hope is on the verge of fading away.

en: at your own absolute purely professional discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion professionnelle pure
ur: آپ کی اپنی بالکل خالص پیشہ ورانہ صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's skills and ethics as a professional.
example_ar: اِتَّخِذْ قَرَارَكَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المِهَنِيِّ الصِّرْفِ.
example_en: Take your decision at your own absolute purely professional discretion.

en: in case statistical clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification statistique
ur: شماریاتی (اعداد و شمار کی) وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the numbers and data explained further.
example_ar: قَدِّمِ الجَدَاوِلَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِحْصَائِيِّ.
example_en: Present the tables in case statistical clarification is requested.

en: over unfortunately defeated generations
fr: au fil des générations malheureusement vaincues
ur: بدقسمتی سے شکست خوردہ نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a tragic period of history where multiple generations faced loss or colonization.
example_ar: ضَاعَ الحَقُّ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْهَزِمَةِ لِلأَسَفِ.
example_en: The right was lost over unfortunately defeated generations.

en: in the twenty-eighth place / twenty-eighthly
fr: en vingt-huitième lieu
ur: اٹھائیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-eighth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّامِنِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، المَصْدَرُ.
example_en: And twenty-eighthly, the source.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْحِيَازِ العِرْقِيِّ
en: unbiased / objective / leaving no room for racial bias
fr: impartial / objectif / ne laissant aucune place aux préjugés raciaux
ur: جس میں نسلی تعصب کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a selection process, a law, or an algorithm that treats all races with absolute equality.
example_ar: القَرَارُ عَدْلٌ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْحِيَازِ العِرْقِيِّ.
example_en: The decision is fair leaving no room for racial bias.

en: hard to apply in practice / difficult to implement
fr: difficile à appliquer en pratique / difficile à mettre en œuvre
ur: جس کا عملی طور پر اطلاق کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for theories, laws, or ideas that sound good but are impossible or very hard to do in the real world.
example_ar: هَذَا المَشْرُوعُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَطْبِيقُهُ عَمَلِيًّا.
example_en: This project is hard to apply in practice.

en: on an encyclopedic cultural scale
fr: à une échelle culturelle encyclopédique
ur: ہمہ گیر (انسائیکلوپیڈیک) ثقافتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing efforts or works that cover a vast, all-encompassing range of human knowledge and heritage.
example_ar: هُوَ بَاحِثٌ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ ثَقَافِيٍّ مَوْسُوعِيٍّ.
example_en: He is a researcher working on an encyclopedic cultural scale.

en: without prior diplomatic warning
fr: sans avertissement diplomatique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی سفارتی وارننگ کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when a country takes a sudden political or military action without talking to other governments first.
example_ar: طُرِدَ السَّفِيرُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِنْذَارٍ دِبْلُومَاسِيٍّ.
example_en: The ambassador was expelled without prior diplomatic warning.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الجُمَالِيَّةِ المَحْضَةِ
en: regardless of purely aesthetic considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations purement esthétiques
ur: محض جمالیاتی (خوبصورتی کے) مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision focuses on function and utility, ignoring how beautiful or ugly something looks.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ المَبْنَى بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الجُمَالِيَّةِ المَحْضَةِ.
example_en: The building was designed regardless of purely aesthetic considerations.

en: at your own logical and scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion logique et scientifique
ur: آپ کی اپنی منطقی اور سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Combines the power of pure reason with the rigor of specialized data.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المَنْطِقِيِّ العِلْمِيِّ.
example_en: Decide at your own logical and scientific discretion.

en: in case geographical clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification géographique
ur: جغرافیائی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the locations, borders, or terrain explained further.
example_ar: نَحْنُ هُنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الجُورَافِيِّ.
example_en: We are here in case geographical clarification is requested.

en: over unfortunately extinguished / faded generations
fr: au fil des générations malheureusement éteintes
ur: بدقسمتی سے بجھی ہوئی (ختم شدہ) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people whose light or influence has completely died out, often due to neglect or tragedy.
example_ar: نُسِيَ التُّرَاثُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْطَفِئَةِ لِلأَسَفِ.
example_en: Heritage was forgotten over unfortunately extinguished generations.

en: in the twenty-ninth place / twenty-ninthly
fr: en vingt-neuvième lieu
ur: انتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the twenty-ninth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ التَّاسِعِ وَالعِشْرِينَ، الاِسْتِدَامَةُ.
example_en: And twenty-ninthly, sustainability.

front: صُمِّمَ المَنْهَجُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً
en: virtuous / correct / leaving no room for behavioral deviation
fr: vertueux / correct / ne laissant aucune place à la déviation comportementale
ur: جس میں اخلاقی بگاڑ (انحراف) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an education system or a social environment that guides people so perfectly they stay on the right path.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ المَنْهَجُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْحِرَافِ السُّلُوكِيِّ.
example_en: The curriculum was designed leaving no room for behavioral deviation.

en: for narrow electoral interest
fr: par intérêt électoral étroit
ur: محدود انتخابی مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to criticize a politician who does something just to win a few more votes, even if it hurts the country in the long run.
example_ar: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِنْتِخَابِيَّةِ الضَّيِّقَةِ.
example_en: He did that for narrow electoral interest.

en: hard to justify ethically / morally indefensible
fr: difficile à justifier éthiquement / moralement indéfendable
ur: جس کا اخلاقی طور پر جواز پیش کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for an action that might be legal or profitable but is clearly wrong according to human values.
example_ar: هَذَا القَرَارُ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَبْرِيرُهُ أَخْلَاقِيًّا.
example_en: This decision is hard to justify ethically.

en: at this promising and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière prometteuse
ur: اس امید افزا اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a positive turning point where great future success is expected.
example_ar: نَحْنُ نَقِفُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الوَاعِدَةِ.
example_en: We stand at this promising and pivotal stage.

en: without prior media coordination
fr: sans coordination médiatique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی میڈیا ہم آہنگی کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when an announcement is made suddenly without preparing the press or the public relations team first.
example_ar: نُشِرَ الخَبَرُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَنْسِيقٍ إِعْلَامِيٍّ.
example_en: The news was published without prior media coordination.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ البِيئِيَّةِ المُعَقَّدَةِ
en: regardless of complex environmental considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations environnementales complexes
ur: پیچیدہ ماحولیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a project must proceed even if the impact on nature and ecology is hard to calculate or fix.
example_ar: بَدَأَ العَمَلُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ البِيئِيَّةِ المُعَقَّدَةِ.
example_en: Work began regardless of complex environmental considerations.

en: at your own sound rational discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion rationnelle saine
ur: آپ کی اپنی درست عقلی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses on the listener's use of healthy, balanced logic that everyone would agree with.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَقْلِيِّ السَّلِيمِ.
example_en: Decide at your own sound rational discretion.

en: in case financial clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification financière
ur: مالی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when an auditor or accountant needs the money trail explained further.
example_ar: أَرْسِلِ الفَوَاتِيرَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ المَالِيِّ.
example_en: Send the invoices in case financial clarification is requested.

en: over completely broken generations
fr: au fil des générations complètement brisées
ur: مکمل طور پر ٹوٹی ہوئی (شکست خوردہ) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people whose spirit, pride, or society has been crushed by long-term oppression or repeated defeat.
example_ar: نُسِيَتِ العِزَّةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْكَسِرَةِ تَمَامًا.
example_en: Glory was forgotten over completely broken generations.

en: in the thirtieth place / thirtiethly
fr: en trentième lieu
ur: تیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirtieth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّعَاوُنُ الدَّوْلِيُّ.
example_en: And thirtiethly, international cooperation.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّدَهْوُرِ المَنَاخِيِّ
en: environmentally stable / leaving no room for climate deterioration
fr: écologiquement stable / ne laissant aucune place à la détérioration climatique
ur: جس میں ماحولیاتی بگاڑ کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an ecological policy or a technological solution so advanced it stops nature from breaking down further.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّدَهْوُرِ المَنَاخِيِّ.
example_en: We work leaving no room for climate deterioration.

en: for the sake of promising investment interest
fr: par intérêt d'investissement prometteur
ur: امید افزا سرمایہ کاری کے مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being motivated by the chance of getting a high financial return in the future.
example_ar: اِشْتَرَيْنَا الأَرْضَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِثْمَارِيَّةِ الوَاعِدَةِ.
example_en: We bought the land for the sake of promising investment interest.

en: hard to bear his/its absence / deeply missed
fr: difficile de supporter son absence / manque cruellement
ur: جس کی کمی (غیر موجودگی) برداشت کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for a beloved person or a vital resource that has gone, leaving a painful gap in life or work.
example_ar: كَانَ الصَّدِيقُ غَالِيًا وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَحَمُّلُ غِيَابِهِ.
example_en: The friend was dear and it was hard to bear his absence.

en: at this mysterious and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière mystérieuse
ur: اس پراسرار اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point where it is not yet clear what the final outcome will be.
example_ar: نَحْنُ نَتَحَرَّكُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الغَامِضَةِ.
example_en: We are moving at this mysterious and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior political agreement
fr: sans aucun accord politique préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی سیاسی معاہدے کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no deals were made between political parties before an action was taken.
example_ar: اِتُّخِذَ القَرَارُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِتِّفَاقٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ مُسْبَقٍ.
example_en: The decision was made without any prior political agreement.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ
en: regardless of sensitive diplomatic considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations diplomatiques sensibles
ur: حساس سفارتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action must be taken even if it offends an ally or causes a major international stir.
example_ar: فَعَلْنَا ذَلِكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ.
example_en: We did that regardless of sensitive diplomatic considerations.

en: on the verge of a breakthrough / easing of tension
fr: sur le point d'un dénouement / d'une détente
ur: کشادگی (حل) کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase describing a difficult situation or a crisis that is finally starting to clear up and move toward a solution.
example_ar: الأَزْمَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الاِنْفِرَاجِ.
example_en: The crisis is on the verge of a breakthrough.

en: at your own purely rational discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion rationnelle pure
ur: آپ کی اپنی محض عقلی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's use of logic, stripping away all social or external pressure.
example_ar: فِكِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَقْلِيِّ البَحْتِ.
example_en: Think at your own purely rational discretion.

en: in case professional clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification professionnelle
ur: پیشہ ورانہ وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the technical and ethical standards of a job explained further.
example_ar: أَنَا هُنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ المِهَنِيِّ.
example_en: I am here in case professional clarification is requested.

front: عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ
en: over generations rising / emitting from the rubble
fr: au fil des générations surgissant des décombres
ur: ملبے سے ابھرنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Dramatic temporal phrase used to describe a people who rebuilt their life and society after a total war or natural disaster.
example_ar: بُنِيَتِ المَدِينَةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ.
example_en: The city was built over generations rising from the rubble.

en: in the thirty-first place / thirty-firstly
fr: en trente et unième lieu
ur: اکتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-first item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الحَادِي وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّقْنِيَّةُ.
example_en: And thirty-firstly, technology.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِسَامِ المُجْتَمَعِيِّ
en: socially unified / leaving no room for societal division
fr: socialement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la division sociétale
ur: جس میں سماجی تقسیم (تفریق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a national identity or a law so strong it prevents people from splitting into fighting groups based on class or tribe.
example_ar: اِتَّحَدْنَا بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِسَامِ المُجْتَمَعِيِّ.
example_en: We united leaving no room for societal division.

en: for the sake of high intelligence interest
fr: par intérêt de renseignement supérieur
ur: اعلیٰ انٹیلیجنس (خفیہ معلومات) کے مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify secret government actions as being necessary for gathering vital security information.
example_ar: السِّرُّ مَحْفُوظٌ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِخْبَارَاتِيَّةِ العَالِيَةِ.
example_en: The secret is kept for the sake of high intelligence interest.

en: hard to overcome this obstacle / difficult hurdle
fr: difficile de franchir cet obstacle / hurdle difficile
ur: اس رکاوٹ کو عبور کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for a major challenge, either physical (a mountain) or metaphorical (a legal problem), that stops progress.
example_ar: الخِلافُ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَجَاوُزُ هَذِهِ العَقَبَةِ.
example_en: The disagreement was hard to overcome (this obstacle).

en: at this accelerating and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière accélérée
ur: اس تیز رفتار اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point where changes are happening faster and faster every day.
example_ar: العَالَمُ يَتَغَيَّرُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ المُتَسَارِعَةِ.
example_en: The world is changing at this accelerating and pivotal stage.

en: without prior psychological preparation
fr: sans préparation psychologique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی نفسیاتی تیاری کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when someone is hit with shocking news or a difficult task without being mentally ready for it first.
example_ar: وَاجَهَ المَشْقَةَ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَهْيِئَةٍ نَفْسِيَّةٍ.
example_en: He faced the hardship without prior psychological preparation.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَقَائِدِيَّةِ الصَّارِمَةِ
en: regardless of strict ideological / dogmatic considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations idéologiques strictes
ur: سخت نظریاتی (عقائدی) مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision is practical and realistic, ignoring the fixed rules of a political or religious dogma.
example_ar: نَتَعَاوَنُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَقَائِدِيَّةِ الصَّارِمَةِ.
example_en: We cooperate regardless of strict ideological considerations.

en: on the verge of melting down / fusion
fr: sur le point de la fusion / de la fonte
ur: پگھلنے (انصہار) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a metal being heated to liquid or, figuratively, a nuclear reactor or a person's brain under extreme stress.
example_ar: المَعْدَنُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الانْصِهَارِ.
example_en: The metal is on the verge of melting.

en: at your own realistic logical discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion logique réaliste
ur: آپ کی اپنی حقیقت پسندانہ منطقی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Combines pure logic with an understanding of how the world actually works (realism).
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المَنْطِقِيِّ الوَاقِعِيِّ.
example_en: Choose at your own realistic logical discretion.

en: in case procedural clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification procédurale
ur: طریقہ کار (پروسیس) کی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the step-by-step rules of a process explained further.
example_ar: نَحْنُ جَاهِزُونَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِجْرَائِيِّ.
example_en: We are ready in case procedural clarification is requested.

front: عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْطَفِئَةِ لِلأَسَفِ الشَّدِيدِ
en: over very unfortunately extinguished generations
fr: au fil des générations très malheureusement éteintes
ur: انتہائی افسوس کے ساتھ بجھی ہوئی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: (Double emphatic). A deeply tragic temporal phrase describing people whose legacy and existence have been totally wiped out by history.
example_ar: اِنْدَثَرَ العِلْمُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْطَفِئَةِ لِلأَسَفِ الشَّدِيدِ.
example_en: Knowledge disappeared over very unfortunately extinguished generations.

en: in the thirty-second place / thirty-secondly
fr: en trente-deuxième lieu
ur: بتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-second item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّانِي وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، الشَّفَافِيَّةُ.
example_en: And thirty-secondly, transparency.

en: for the sake of pure professional interest
fr: par intérêt professionnel pur
ur: خالص پیشہ ورانہ مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being motivated entirely by the rules and ethics of a job, with no personal feelings involved.
example_ar: نَصَحْتُهُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ النَّقِيَّةِ.
example_en: I advised him for the sake of pure professional interest.

en: hard to avoid side effects / inevitable consequences
fr: difficile d'éviter les effets secondaires / conséquences inévitables
ur: جس کے ضمنی اثرات (سائیڈ ایفیکٹس) سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used in medicine, economics, or politics when a necessary action will definitely cause some smaller, unwanted problems.
example_ar: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الآثَارِ الجَانِبِيَّةِ لِهَذَا الدَّوَاءِ.
example_en: It is hard to avoid the side effects of this medicine.

en: without any prior documented financial commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement financier documenté préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی دستاویزی مالی عہد (کمٹمنٹ) کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no money was promised or signed for before an action was taken.
example_ar: بَدَأَ المَشْرُوعُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ مَالِيٍّ مُوَثَّقٍ.
example_en: The project started without any prior documented financial commitment.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ
en: regardless of fleeting psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques éphémères
ur: عارضی نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision ignores short-term feelings like fear or excitement, focusing on long-term facts.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ.
example_en: Decide regardless of fleeting psychological considerations.

en: on the verge of radical / fundamental transformation
fr: sur le point d'une transformation radicale
ur: بنیادی (جڑ سے) تبدیلی کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a situation that is about to change so completely that its original form will be unrecognizable.
example_ar: التِّكْنُولُوجِيَا عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّحَوُّلِ الجِذْرِيِّ.
example_en: Technology is on the verge of radical transformation.

en: at your own purely scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique pure
ur: آپ کی اپنی خالص سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's expertise in a field of study, ignoring opinion.
example_ar: قَيِّمِ المَوْضُوعَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ الصِّرْفِ.
example_en: Evaluate the subject at your own purely scientific discretion.

en: in the thirty-third place / thirty-thirdly
fr: en trente-troisième lieu
ur: تنتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-third item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّالِثِ وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، الثَّقَافَةُ.
example_en: And thirty-thirdly, culture.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ الطَّبَقِيِّ
en: egalitarian / leaving no room for class disparity
fr: égalitaire / ne laissant aucune place à la disparité de classe
ur: جس میں طبقاتی فرق (اونچ نیچ) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a social system or a salary structure where everyone is treated so equally that social classes disappear.
example_ar: صُمِّمَ النِّظَامُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ الطَّبَقِيِّ.
example_en: The system was designed leaving no room for class disparity.

en: for the sake of existential strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique existentiel
ur: وجودی تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify actions that are necessary for the very survival of a nation or an organization.
example_ar: نُحَارِبُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ الوُجُودِيَّةِ.
example_en: We fight for the sake of existential strategic interest.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي الفَخِّ
en: hard to avoid falling into the trap
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans le piège
ur: جال (پھندے) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used when a situation is so cleverly set up that even a careful person will likely be tricked or make a mistake.
example_ar: الخُطَّةُ ذَكِيَّةٌ وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي الفَخِّ.
example_en: The plan is clever and it is hard to avoid falling into the trap.

en: at this confused and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière confuse
ur: اس الجھے ہوئے (پریشان کن) اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point where there is a lot of chaos, lack of leadership, and uncertainty about what to do.
example_ar: النَّاسُ تَائِهُونَ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ المُرْتَبِكَةِ.
example_en: People are lost at this confused and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior binding political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique contraignant préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی لازمی (بائنڈنگ) سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no legal or official promises were made that forced a politician to act a certain way.
example_ar: جَاءَ الدَّعْمُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ مُلْزِمٍ.
example_en: Support came without any prior binding political commitment.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العِرْقِيَّةِ الضَّيِّقَةِ
en: regardless of narrow racial considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations raciales étroites
ur: محدود نسلی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision is fair to all humans, ignoring the tribal or racial background of the people involved.
example_ar: اِحْكُمْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العِرْقِيَّةِ الضَّيِّقَةِ.
example_en: Judge regardless of narrow racial considerations.

en: on the verge of crashing / shattering / breaking
fr: sur le point de se fracasser / de se briser
ur: ٹوٹنے (تباہ ہونے) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a plane about to hit the ground, or a person's dreams being destroyed by reality.
example_ar: الطَّائِرَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّحَطُّمِ.
example_en: The plane is on the verge of crashing.

en: at your own precise scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique précise
ur: آپ کی اپنی دقیق سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's specialized data and expert measurements.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ الدَّقِيقِ.
example_en: Decide at your own precise scientific discretion.

en: in case sanitation clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification sanitaire
ur: صفائی ستھرائی (سینیٹیشن) کی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a health inspector needs the waste management or cleanliness systems explained further.
example_ar: قَدِّمِ المِلَفَّ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِصْحَاحِيِّ.
example_en: Present the file in case sanitation clarification is requested.

en: in the thirty-fourth place / thirty-fourthly
fr: en trente-quatrième lieu
ur: چونتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-fourth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الرَّابِعِ وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّعْلِيمُ.
example_en: And thirty-fourthly, education.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَايُنِ المَعْرِفِيِّ
en: intellectually unified / leaving no room for knowledge disparity
fr: intellectuellement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la disparité des connaissances
ur: جس میں علمی تفاوت (فرق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an information system or an education program that ensures everyone has exactly the same high level of data and facts.
example_ar: وُزِّعَتِ المَعْلُومَاتُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَايُنِ المَعْرِفِيِّ.
example_en: Information was distributed leaving no room for knowledge disparity.

en: for the sake of comprehensive strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique global
ur: ہمہ گیر تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being part of a master plan that covers every part of a nation's or company's future.
example_ar: نَتَحَرَّكُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ الشَّامِلَةِ.
example_en: We move for the sake of comprehensive strategic interest.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَنْزَلِ
en: hard to avoid falling into this house / trap (metaphor)
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans cette maison / ce piège
ur: اس مقام (حالت) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: (Specific metaphorical usage). Phrase used when a person is destined to end up in a specific state of life, status, or house regardless of their efforts.
example_ar: القَدَرُ غَالِبٌ وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَنْزَلِ.
example_en: Fate is dominant and it is hard to avoid falling into this house (state).

en: without any prior official political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique officiel préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی سرکاری سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no government papers were signed or official words spoken that forced a decision.
example_ar: اِتُّخِذَ المَوْقِفُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ رَسْمِيٍّ.
example_en: The position was taken without any prior official political commitment.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَمِيقَةِ
en: regardless of deep psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques profondes
ur: گہرے نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision ignores hidden traumas, complex emotions, or subconscious fears, focusing only on cold reality.
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَمِيقَةِ.
example_en: Choose regardless of deep psychological considerations.

en: at your own scientific and technical discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique et technique
ur: آپ کی اپنی سائنسی اور فنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Combines the precision of hard data with the skilled eye of an expert practitioner.
example_ar: اِحْكُمْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ الفَنِّيِّ.
example_en: Judge at your own scientific and technical discretion.

en: in case ecological clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification écologique
ur: ماحولیاتی (ایکولوجیکل) وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a scientist or environmentalist needs the ecosystem balance explained further.
example_ar: قَدِّمِ الخَرَائِطَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِيكُولُوجِيِّ.
example_en: Present the maps in case ecological clarification is requested.
