en: in the thirty-fifth place / thirty-fifthly
fr: en trente-cinquième lieu
ur: پینتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-fifth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الخَامِسِ وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّصْنِيعُ.
example_en: And thirty-fifthly, manufacturing.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ اللُّغَوِيِّ
en: linguistically unified / leaving no room for language disparity
fr: linguistiquement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la disparité linguistique
ur: جس میں لسانی تفاوت (زبان کے فرق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a communication system or a textbook that explains everything so perfectly that even people with different dialects understand exactly the same thing.
example_ar: كُتِبَ الدَّلِيلُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ اللُّغَوِيِّ.
example_en: The guide was written leaving no room for language disparity.

en: for the sake of distant / long-term strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique lointain / à long terme
ur: دور رس تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify actions that are taken for a goal that is many years or decades away, requiring great patience.
example_ar: نُخَطِّطُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ البَعِيدَةِ.
example_en: We plan for the sake of distant strategic interest.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَطَبِّ
en: hard to avoid falling into this pitfall / bump (metaphor)
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans ce piège / ce cahot
ur: اس غلطی (گڑھے) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used when a specific error or difficulty is so common and easy to make that almost everyone falls for it.
example_ar: هَذَا خَطَأٌ شَائِعٌ وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَطَبِّ.
example_en: This is a common mistake and it is hard to avoid falling into this pitfall.

en: without any prior explicit political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique explicite préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی واضح سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no clear, written, or spoken promises were made by politicians before an action was taken.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَ الحَالُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ صَرِيحٍ.
example_en: The situation changed without any prior explicit political commitment.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ لِلأَسَفِ
en: regardless of unfortunately fleeting psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques malheureusement éphémères
ur: بدقسمتی سے عارضی نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision must ignore short-term feelings (like fear), even though it is sad to do so, focusing only on facts.
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ لِلأَسَفِ.
example_en: Choose regardless of unfortunately fleeting psychological considerations.

en: on the verge of final disappearance / vanishing
fr: sur le point de la disparition finale
ur: حتمی طور پر مٹ جانے (غائب ہونے) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing something that is about to go away for the last time, with no possibility of it ever returning or being remembered.
example_ar: هَذِهِ اللُّغَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّلاشِي النِّهَائِيِّ.
example_en: This language is on the verge of final disappearance.

en: at your own objective scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique objective
ur: آپ کی اپنی معروضی (آبجیکٹیو) سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's data and measurements, ensuring they are not influenced by personal bias.
example_ar: قَيِّمِ البَحْثَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ المَوْضُوعِيِّ.
example_en: Evaluate the research at your own objective scientific discretion.

en: in case hydrological clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification hydrologique
ur: آبی (ہائیڈرولوجیکل) وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a water expert needs the river flow, dams, or water distribution explained further.

ur: جیو پولیٹیکل تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify actions (like starting a war or closing a sea-path) as being vital for the nation's power based on geography.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَأْزِقِ
